### [1] [Application of Artificial Intelligence for Fraudulent Banking Operations Recognition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07471)
*Bohdan Mytnyk,Oleksandr Tkachyk,Nataliya Shakhovska,Solomiia Fedushko,Yuriy Syerov*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本研究探讨应用机器学习算法识别银行欺诈交易，重点开发人工神经网络模型并进行数据预处理，以提高欺诈交易检测准确率。实验表明，逻辑回归算法表现最佳（AUC约0.946），而堆叠泛化方法达到更高AUC为0.954。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 新冠疫情促使大量银行业务转向线上平台，同时催生了众多可被犯罪分子利用的慈善基金，导致银行欺诈案件显著增加，亟需有效的自动识别工具来应对这一日益严峻的数字化社会安全问题。

Method: 采用多种机器学习算法（包括逻辑回归和人工神经网络）对银行在线交易数据进行欺诈检测；通过处理高度不平衡数据集、特征变换和特征工程等预处理技术提升检测精度，并采用堆叠泛化策略集成多种模型，最终对各类算法结果进行可视化比较与评估。

Result: 人工神经网络模型有效提高了欺诈交易检测精度；在各独立算法中，逻辑回归表现最优，AUC值约为0.946；堆叠泛化集成方法进一步提升了性能，AUC达到0.954。

Conclusion: 人工智能算法在银行欺诈识别领域具有显著有效性，堆叠泛化方法的性能优于单一算法，表明集成学习策略是提升欺诈检测准确率的可行方向，该研究对数字社会中的金融安全防护具有实践意义。

Abstract: This study considers the task of applying artificial intelligence to recognize bank fraud. In recent years, due to the COVID19 pandemic, bank fraud has become even more common due to the massive transition of many operations to online platforms and the creation of many charitable funds that criminals can use to deceive users. The present work focuses on machine learning algorithms as a tool well suited for analyzing and recognizing online banking transactions. The study`s scientific novelty is the development of machine learning models for identifying fraudulent banking transactions and techniques for preprocessing bank data for further comparison and selection of the best results. This paper also details various methods for improving detection accuracy, i.e., handling highly imbalanced datasets, feature transformation, and feature engineering. The proposed model, which is based on an artificial neural network, effectively improves the accuracy of fraudulent transaction detection. The results of the different algorithms are visualized, and the logistic regression algorithm performs the best, with an output AUC value of approximately 0,946. The stacked generalization shows a better AUC of 0.954. The recognition of banking fraud using artificial intelligence algorithms is a topical issue in our digital society.

</details>


### [2] [Data-Driven Fire-Zone Segmentation for Improved Short-Term Wildfire Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07472)
*Nicolas Caron,Christophe Guyeux,Hassan Noura,Benjamin Aynes*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出了一种基于无监督火区分割的野火预测方法，通过流域检测结合K-means聚类来定义预测单元，替代传统的均匀网格划分，实验表明在六个法国省份和六个预测模型中稳定提升IoU 3-6%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统野火预测模型将研究区域离散化为均匀网格，忽略了点火事件的空间异质性分布。本文认为离散化方式比模型选择对预测性能的影响更大，因此挑战这一范式。

Method: 提出无监督火区分割算法，将流域检测与K-means聚类相结合，直接从历史火点模式中定义预测单元，替代均匀网格。

Result: 在六个法国省份和六个预测模型上的实验表明，火区分割方法持续优于基于网格的方法，平均IoU提升3-6%（取决于空间尺度），且计算轻量（每种配置<10秒），完全可并行化。

Conclusion: 优化空间离散化策略能带来显著且可复现的短期野火预报性能提升，证明了空间离散化比模型选择更值得关注。

Abstract: Wildfire prediction models typically discretize study areas into uniform grids, ignoring the heterogeneous spatial distribution of ignitions. We challenge this paradigm by showing that how data is discretized matters more than which model is used. We propose an unsupervised fire-zone segmentation algorithm combining watershed detection with K-means clustering to define prediction units directly from historical fire patterns. Experiments across six French departments and six forecasting models show that fire-zone segmentation consistently outperforms grid-based approaches, with mean IoU improvements of +3--6% depending on spatial scale. The method is computationally lightweight (<10s per configuration) and fully parallelizable. Our results demonstrate that optimizing spatial discretization yields significant, reproducible performance gains for short-term wildfire forecasting.

</details>


### [3] [Evolving Safety Landscape of Multi-modal Large Language Models: A Survey of Emerging Threats and Safeguards](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07535)
*Xi Li,Shu Zhao,Xiaohan Zou,Fei Zhao,Fuxiao Liu,Yusen Zhang,Cheng Han,Yushun Dong,Jiaqi Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文系统综述了多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）的安全景观，提出了一种基于多模态的分类体系来梳理安全威胁，分析了威胁模型的演变（涵盖对抗攻击、数据投毒、越狱和幻觉），并总结了更新的安全假设与相应的安全策略，最后讨论了开放挑战和未来方向。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MLLMs通过模态对齐和融合集成异构模态，提升了理解与推理能力，但架构转变重塑了机器学习的安全格局。模型复杂度增加和跨模态交互带来了新的威胁（如模态整合受损、模态错配、融合安全风险），现有基于单模态学习的框架无法覆盖这些新约束，因此需要系统分析MLLMs的安全演变。

Method: 本文采用综述方法：(1) 提出一种多模态grounded的安全威胁分类体系，分析威胁模型演变，涵盖对抗攻击、数据投毒、越狱和幻觉四类威胁；(2) 总结更新后的安全假设；(3) 据此组织并梳理MLLM安全策略的最新进展。

Result: 提出了多模态导向的安全威胁分类体系，系统梳理了MLLMs中威胁模型的四类转变，总结了安全假设的更新，并整理了最新的安全策略研究进展。

Conclusion: 本文揭示了MLLMs安全研究面临的新挑战，指出现有单模态安全框架的局限，并通过分类体系和策略梳理为多模态系统更原则性、可扩展的安全机制开发提供了方向指引。

Abstract: Multi-modal large language models (MLLMs) integrate heterogeneous modalities through modality alignment and fusion, enabling stronger understanding and reasoning. However, this architectural shift reshapes the safety landscape of machine learning. Increased model complexity and cross-modal interactions give rise to novel threats, including compromised modality integration, modality misalignment, and fused safety risks, reflecting shifts in threat modeling beyond uni-modal assumptions. These shifts, in turn, impose new constraints on safety solutions not captured by existing frameworks rooted in uni-modal learning. Motivated by these challenges, this survey provides a systematic analysis of the evolving safety landscape of MLLMs. We first propose a multimodal grounded taxonomy of safety threats and analyze shifts in threat models, covering adversarial attacks, data poisoning, jailbreaks, and hallucinations. We then summarize updated safety assumptions and organize recent advances in MLLM safety strategies accordingly. Finally, we discuss open challenges and future directions to inform the development of more principled and scalable safety mechanisms for multimodal systems.

</details>


### [4] [Tracing sources of epistemic uncertainty in deep learning predictions: homo- and hetero-scedastic linearized estimators](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07630)
*Pierre Nodet,Thomas George*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出将两种经典统计估计器适配到现代深度学习中，用于量化两类不确定性的来源：偶然不确定性（aleatoric uncertainty）和局部数据稀缺导致的不确定性（epistemic uncertainty）。通过利用近似Fisher信息矩阵的最新进展，该方法可扩展到实际架构。实验表明每个测试点受两种来源的影响不同，验证了估计器在提升真实应用鲁棒性方面的实用价值。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度学习中不确定性量化对于可靠性至关重要的应用（如医疗、自动驾驶等）具有重要意义，但现有方法难以清晰区分不确定性是来自于数据本身的噪声（偶然不确定性）还是训练数据的局部稀缺。经典统计估计器虽然理论成熟，却无法直接扩展到现代深度学习架构，因此需要一种既能区分两类不确定性来源又具备可扩展性的方法。

Method: 本文方法的核心是将两种经典统计估计器适配到深度学习的框架中。具体而言，利用近似Fisher信息矩阵（Approximate Fisher Information Matrix）的最新进展，使得这些统计估计器能够在大规模深度学习架构上高效运行。通过该框架同时对偶然不确定性（源于数据噪声）和认知不确定性（源于局部数据稀缺）进行量化分析。

Result: 实验结果表明，每个测试点受到两类不确定性来源的影响程度是不同的，即不同数据点对偶然不确定性和数据稀缺带来的不确定性的暴露程度存在差异。这证明了所提估计器能够提供细粒度的不确定性归因，展示了其在实际应用中提升模型鲁棒性的实用价值。

Conclusion: 将经典统计估计器与近似Fisher信息矩阵相结合，可以有效且可扩展地区分深度学习中的偶然不确定性和因数据稀缺产生的不确定性。该方法为实践中更好地理解模型预测的不确定性来源提供了清晰洞见，有助于改进真实世界应用的鲁棒性。

Abstract: We adapt two classical statistical estimators for quantifying uncertainty to modern deep learning, in order to provide clearer insights into uncertainty attributable to two sources : aleatoric uncertainty, or locally scarce data. Our approach leverages recent advances in approximate Fisher Information Matrices, to enable scaling to actual architectures. Experimental results demonstrate how each test points is differentially impacted by both sources, highlighting the practical utility of our estimators in improving the robustness of real-world applications.

</details>


### [5] [SkillConsist: Detecting Inconsistencies in Agent Skills via Bidirectional Graph Alignment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07639)
*Chaofan Meng,Yuhang Zheng,Yingnan Zhou,Sihan Xu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: SkillConsist是一个用于检测LLM Agent技能声明与实现行为不一致的系统，通过行为图构建、双向图对齐和差分分析，在633个技能的基准上达到87.93%的F1分数，比最佳基线提升20.43个百分点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Agent Skill的一致性检测很重要，因为不一致可能导致未披露的危险行为或错误的技能选择。现有方法存在两个挑战：(1) 声明和实现行为可能混合在文本和代码中，难以分离；(2) 简洁的声明可能对应多个相互关联的实现步骤，现有方法难以处理这种多步骤的对应关系。

Method: SkillConsist采用三阶段方法：(1) 使用LLM将声明和实现内容分离为行为记录，并用静态分析补充实现端记录，分别构建声明行为图和实现行为图；(2) 从任意一侧的行为记录出发，在另一侧图中进行双向图对齐搜索，寻找候选子图并沿行为关系扩展直到完全表达源侧行为；(3) 通过图差分识别对齐子图之间的冲突并输出检测结果。

Result: 在由ClawHub前500个最常下载的Skill和133个Skill-Inject包构建的633-Skill基准上（含319个不一致和314个一致的Skill，以及442个局部不一致标注），SkillConsist在包级别检测上达到86.85%的精确率、89.03%的召回率和87.93%的F1分数，F1比最佳基线提升20.43个百分点；在局部定位任务上达到67.60%精确率、58.14%召回率和62.52%的F1分数。

Conclusion: SkillConsist通过将声明-实现不一致检测建模为行为图的双向对齐与差分问题，有效解决了声明与实现内容混合以及单一声明对应多步骤实现这两大挑战，显著优于现有基线方法。

Abstract: Agent Skills provide reusable capabilities to LLM agents. Agent Skill inconsistencies can expose undisclosed dangerous behavior or cause wrong Skill selection. Recent Agent Skill research has increasingly examined Agent Skill consistency detection. Existing methods evaluate behaviors or security-property graphs against predefined categories or declared scopes. More recently, PL-HCL uses an LLM-based model to learn consistency across metadata, instructions, and resources. However, declaration and implementation behavior can be mixed across text and code, and a concise declaration can correspond to multiple connected implementation steps. We present SkillConsist to address both challenges. An LLM separates declaration and implementation content into behavior records on the implementation and declaration sides, while static analysis supplements implementation records. These records form declaration and implementation behavior graphs, respectively. Starting from a behavior record on either side, bidirectional graph alignment searches the other graph for a candidate subgraph and expands it along behavior relations until it completely expresses the source-side behavior. Graph differencing identifies conflicts between aligned subgraphs and outputs the detection results. We construct a 633-Skill benchmark from ClawHub's 500 most-downloaded public Skills and 133 Skill-Inject packages. The benchmark contains 319 inconsistent and 314 consistent Skills and 442 localized inconsistency annotations. On this benchmark, SkillConsist achieves 86.85% precision, 89.03% recall, and 87.93% F1 for package-level detection, improving F1 over the best baseline by 20.43 percentage points. For localization, it achieves 67.60% precision, 58.14% recall, and 62.52% F1.

</details>


### [6] [PhysAttNet: Enhancing Predictive Performance in Industrial and Astrophysical Time Series via Physics-Informed Attention](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07681)
*Amal Saadallah,Julia Tjus,Petra Wiederkeher,Wolfgang Rhode*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出PhysAttNet，一种物理信息引导的注意力框架，用于时间序列预测。它通过对轻量级CNN预测器的注意力头施加三种基于物理信号的领域知识正则化（对齐、平滑度、稀疏性），在不需人工标注的情况下提升预测精度、泛化能力和对关键物理事件的预测性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: CNN在时间序列预测中广泛应用，但其学习到的时序注意力模式往往不稳定或物理上不一致，导致鲁棒性、泛化性和可解释性下降。物理过程中存在噪声、变异性和测量不确定性，需要模型在捕捉时间局部结构（对应物理事件）的同时保持可靠。

Method: PhysAttNet在轻量级CNN预测器上增加一个由领域信息正则化引导的注意力头。训练时施加三种可微约束：1）对齐正则化——鼓励注意力遵循输入信号中平滑、峰值中心的时间结构；2）平滑度正则化——强制时序演化的连续性；3）稀疏正则化——促进对信息区间的选择性聚焦。这些正则化提供物理引导的归纳偏置，无需标注解释或人工监督。

Result: 在铣削过程中切削力预测和blazar耀斑时间序列预测两个应用中，PhysAttNet相比基线在预测精度、泛化能力以及对结构性重要事件的预测性能上均有所提升。

Conclusion: 通过将物理结构知识以可微正则化形式注入注意力机制，PhysAttNet在保持CNN计算效率的同时提升了时间序列预测的准确性、鲁棒性和可解释性，为物理过程建模提供了一个有效且无需人工标注的解决方案。

Abstract: Accurate and robust time series forecasting is essential in many applications involving physical processes, such as manufacturing monitoring and astrophysical event detection. In these settings, predictive models must remain reliable under noise, variability, and measurement uncertainty while capturing temporally localized structures corresponding to physically meaningful events. Convolutional neural networks (CNNs) are widely used for such tasks due to their computational efficiency and strong representational capacity. However, their learned temporal representations often exhibit unstable or physically inconsistent attention patterns, reducing robustness, generalization, and interpretability. This paper introduces PhysAttNet, a physics-informed attention framework for time series forecasting. PhysAttNet augments a lightweight CNN forecaster with an attention head guided by domain-informed regularization reflecting the structural properties of physical signals. Specifically, three complementary constraints are imposed during training: an alignment regularization that encourages attention to follow smooth, peak-centered temporal structures derived from the input signal, a smoothness regularization that enforces continuous temporal evolution, and a sparsity regularization that promotes selective focus on informative intervals. These differentiable regularization terms introduce physics-guided inductive bias without requiring annotated explanations or manual supervision. Experiments on two distinct applications, namely predicting cutting forces during milling and forecasting flares in blazar time series, demonstrate that PhysAttNet improves forecasting accuracy, generalization, and prediction performance on structurally important events.

</details>


### [7] [CODS: Iterative Bellman-Residual Data Selection for Reusable Offline Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07719)
*Ibne Farabi Shihab,Sanjeda Akter,Abu Sa-Adat Mohamed Moon-Im Al Ahsan,Md Najmus Swaqeeb,Anuj Sharma*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: CODS是一种批评者引导的离线强化学习数据选择方法，通过交替训练算法匹配的批评者并获取高残差转移来生成可重用的静态数据子集，在10%预算下保留96.6%的可用池性能，优于多个基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 离线强化学习从固定转移池反复训练策略，跨种子和超参数的冗余数据计算成本高昂；而朴素子采样可能移除长时程信用分配所需的稀有转移。

Method: CODS交替执行两个步骤：拟合与算法匹配的批评者，以及获取高残差转移。与优先重放不同，CODS生成静态工件；与一次性残差选择不同，它在批评者变化时刷新评分。支持多轮获取（约5轮饱和）和全轨迹扩展。

Result: 在10%预算下，CODS在20个有效的D4RL任务-算法单元中保留96.6%的可选池性能；在19/20单元上超过ReDOR和OPER，在所有20/20单元上超过其他子集基线。5轮获取比1轮提高11.23分。全轨迹扩展保留95.4%的ALFWorld和96.5%的GSM8K性能。

Conclusion: CODS是一种可重用的选择流程而非正式的coreset保证，通过批评者引导的自适应获取实现高效的数据复用。

Abstract: Offline reinforcement learning repeatedly trains policies from a fixed transition pool, making redundant data costly across seeds and hyperparameters, while naive subsampling can remove rare transitions needed for long-horizon credit assignment. We introduce CODS, a critic-guided selector that alternates between fitting an algorithm-matched critic and acquiring high-residual transitions before freezing a reusable subset. Unlike prioritized replay, CODS produces a static artifact; unlike one-shot residual selection, it refreshes scores as the critic changes. At a 10\% budget, CODS retains 96.6\% of eligible-pool performance across 20 valid D4RL task--algorithm cells. It exceeds ReDOR and OPER on 19/20 cells and every other subset baseline on 20/20; all six subset advantages remain significant under predeclared hierarchical inference with Holm correction. Holding total selector updates fixed, five acquisition rounds improve four representative cells by 11.23 points over one round and saturate thereafter. Equal-pass and equal-hour evaluations clarify that reuse, rather than a single-run speedup, creates the compute advantage. Mechanism and corruption interventions expose both useful sparse-reward enrichment and sensitivity to outliers. Finally, a whole-trace extension retains 95.4\% of pooled ALFWorld success and 96.5\% of pooled GSM8K exact match. CODS is therefore a reusable selection procedure, not a formal coreset guarantee.

</details>


### [8] [Neural Operators for Immersed-Boundary Soft Swimmers Locomotion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07722)
*Mohammad Sadegh Eshaghi,Yizheng Wang,Navid Valizadeh,Xiaoying Zhuang,Timon Rabczuk*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文开发基于神经算子代理模型的水动力场时间预测模型，用于平面和三维鳗鱼游泳者。平面模型联合预测速度、涡度和压力，在五个高雷诺数轨迹上全局相对L2误差为3.51%；三维模型分别预测速度（3.44%）、涡度（5.58%）和压力（19.2%）。研究表明移动边界游泳者流场的高保真神经代理是可行的，但压力精度和物理一致性仍需改进。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高保真沉浸边界法模拟能够解析变形游泳者与其周围流场的耦合运动，但计算成本限制了其在工程设计、参数研究和控制中的重复评估。需要开发低成本代理模型来加速这些场景下的流场预测。

Method: 训练基于神经算子（neural operator）的代理模型，用于预测平面和三维鳗鱼游泳者产生的流体动力学场。代理模型以自适应流固耦合模拟导出的规则网格场为训练数据，并以游泳者几何形状和雷诺数作为条件输入。平面模型联合预测两个速度分量、标量涡度和压力；三维模型则使用三个具有共同多通道输入的目标特异性模型，分别预测三维速度、涡度和压力。

Result: 平面模型在五个留出的高雷诺数轨迹上实现3.51%的全域全局相对L2误差；三维模型在五个留出的轨迹上，速度模型误差为3.44%，涡度模型为5.58%，压力模型为19.2%。

Conclusion: 研究证明了对于移动边界游泳者流场，基于场解析的神经代理模型是可行的，同时指出了压力预测精度和物理一致性是未来进一步发展的优先方向。

Abstract: High-fidelity immersed-boundary simulation resolves the coupled motion of a deforming swimmer and its surrounding flow, but the resulting cost limits repeated evaluations for engineering design, parameter studies, and control. We develop neural-operator surrogates for temporal prediction of the hydrodynamic fields generated by planar and volumetric eel swimmers. The surrogates are trained on regular-grid fields exported from adaptive fluid--structure simulations and are conditioned on swimmer geometry and Reynolds number. Motivation: 多轮ReAct智能体的KV缓存随推理链增长而膨胀，导致内存和注意力计算开销增加。现有KV压缩方法基于当前轮次的注意力分数进行驱逐，但低注意力不等于未来不相关——暂时不活跃的信息可能在后续轮次重新变得重要。快照式驱逐方法无法明确区分"暂时休眠"的信息和"已结束其作用"的信息，导致误删重要状态或保留无用状态。

Abstract: Multi-turn Reasoning-and-Acting (ReAct) agents accumulate growing trajectories of reasoning, tool calls, and observations. Their key-value (KV) caches grow accordingly, increasing memory use and attention cost during model inference. Existing KV cache compression methods reduce these costs by evicting states with low attention scores. However, low attention in the current turn does not imply future irrelevance, as temporarily inactive information may become important later. Specifically, CommitKV first divides completed agent events into token pages and compares each eligible page's deletion effect before a tool-call commit and after the commit's returned observation has been incorporated. Based on these paired measurements, CommitKV distinguishes dormant pages from high-to-low completion candidates. It then applies a greedy joint test, accepting candidates for retirement only when their combined post-commit effect remains bounded. Finally, at a later compression checkpoint, accepted pages are excluded, a bounded set of pages awaiting post-commit measurement is protected, and the remaining KV states are retained within the cache budget using the same token indices for keys, values, and absolute positions. These mechanisms ensure that CommitKV can distinguish dormant information from information that has completed its observed role and can be safely removed. Experiments on various benchmarks show that CommitKV reduces agent memory use, accelerates end-to-end inference, and achieves higher accuracy than existing KV cache compression methods.

Abstract: Preferential Bayesian optimization (PBO) optimizes objectives accessible only through pairwise user comparisons. The standard approach fits a Gaussian process surrogate for observed pairwise comparisons (PairwiseGP) using the Laplace approximation and selects queries with the Expected Utility of Best Option (EUBO) acquisition function. This deficiency is structural and cannot be resolved by changing the surrogate modeling approach. Existing approaches to remedy this issue either waste query budget by forcing comparisons to stay connected, or apply uniform regularization that also perturbs directions already well-constrained by the observed comparisons. The correction is only applied in the model fitting step, not query selection. Abstract: Multimodal emotion recognition often treats self-reported labels as reliable supervision while overlooking self-report unreliability and cross-modal conflict. Experiments on the prototype show that compared to BP-based baselines, ZeroLock reduces the memory by 26.5% and improves throughput by 4.9%.

Abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems in production operate under strict service level objectives (SLOs) on tail latency and infrastructure cost. Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly read long inputs in the agentic era, from whole documents and codebases to conversations across many turns. Their inference memory is then dominated by the key-value (KV) cache, the stored attention keys and values of every token the model has read and generated. Because the cache grows with context length and is re-read in full at every generated token, a longer context means more GPU memory.
  To reduce this cost, most existing methods compress the KV cache by lowering every stored value to the same low precision, a technique known as quantization. They can push this to nearly two bits per value, but rarely further, because quality drops sharply at this 2-bit cliff: four levels are too few for the cache's outlier-heavy values, where a few large entries consume the levels and collapse the rest into noise. A natural remedy is to spend more bits on the channels (feature dimensions) that matter and fewer on the rest, but the raw cache offers no handle: its channels are strongly correlated, so none stands out as more important.

There, a small fraction of channels carries almost all the information, and spending the budget on those few is far more accurate than spreading it evenly.
  Guided by this analysis, we develop SPECTRA, a training-free, drop-in codec that re-encodes the cache into this coordinate system and concentrates the bit budget on the channels that carry the signal. On Llama-3.1-8B and Qwen2.5-7B over long-context benchmarks, SPECTRA is near-lossless at 4x compression, competitive at 8x where uniform quantization has collapsed, and reaches up to 12x, pushing usable compression past the 2-bit cliff so the same GPU holds longer contexts and larger batches.

Abstract: On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) adapts a language model by distilling guidance from a frozen teacher on trajectories sampled from the student. Abstract: Low-rank adaptation (LoRA) represents large language model (LLM) updates with two compact matrix factors, i.e., $A$ and $B$, providing an efficient way to fine-tune large models in federated learning paradigm. Abstract: Load Balancing has emerged as a critical problem in expert-parallel distributed inference of Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models. As routing distributions are typically skewed across experts, devices hosting lighter-loaded experts must idle to wait for the heaviest during expert computing, leading to inefficiency. Existing load-balancing approaches primarily rely on expert replication or migration within each layer, which introduce additional overhead and limit their flexibility and scalability. To address this problem, we propose EasyBalance, a cross-layer load balancing strategy that requires no modifications to the expert-device mapping, enabling instant adaptability and incurring essentially no additional overhead. Our key insights are that (1) experts of other layers can be viewed as naturally redundant for the current layer, and (2) cross-layer MoE workloads can be jointly executed to mitigate their individual imbalance. Based on these observations, EasyBalance greedily schedules a subset of cross-layer workloads to run at each MoE step and defers the remaining workloads for future balancing opportunities, effectively leveraging cross-layer imbalance mitigation. Extensive experiments across models, tasks, and configurations demonstrate that EasyBalance consistently accelerates distributed MoE inference, reducing GPU idling by mostly over 40%. </details>

Abstract: Language-model judges and reward models enable scalable supervision, but finite optimization can exploit evaluator errors rather than improve response quality. We characterize this failure through the covariance geometry of evaluator ensembles. Recently, time series foundation models (TSFMs), pretrained on large-scale datasets, have demonstrated strong generalization capabilities and emerged as an important paradigm for TSF. Reinforcement learning (RL) post-training has consequently attracted growing attention as a means of further improving their performance on downstream tasks. However, we find that, in certain forecast regions, RL post-training may gradually shift the output distributions of TSFMs away from the ground truth, thereby limiting their performance. We refer to this phenomenon as \textbf{suboptimal collapse}. Our analysis suggests that difficulty in initially sampling high-quality trajectories near the ground truth is an important contributing factor to suboptimal collapse. Abstract: Attention mechanisms have been widely utilized in modern deep learning, and many existing multi-omics models inherit their conventional use to allow unrestricted bidirectional interactions. However, the fundamental logic of life is directional. We outline the practical implications of these findings for auditing data-centric AI workflows within regulated financial institutions.

Abstract: Multivariate Time Series Classification (MTSC) demands models that can effectively capture complex temporal patterns across multiple scales while remaining computationally efficient. In this paper, we present FreSH, a Frequency-Segmented Hierarchical Multi-Expert Framework designed to address these challenges. FreSH introduces a new perspective for MTSC by enabling adaptive, multi-scale analysis of temporal signals, allowing different aspects of the data to be modeled in a complementary and coordinated manner. By combining localized specialization with holistic context modeling, FreSH achieves strong representational capacity without incurring excessive computational overhead. An adaptive fusion strategy further enhances flexibility, enabling the model to dynamically emphasize the most informative components of the input. In addition, we incorporate a more robust optimization objective that improves learning stability across varying sample difficulties and class distributions. Abstract: Reinforcement learning post-training unlocks complex reasoning in LLMs. Yet benchmark scores reveal only whether a model improved, not what changed inside it, nor how it splits finite capability across tasks. A representative interpretability line attributes the success of RL fine-tuning to stronger and more diverse circuit activation. We challenge this activation-centered account by separating activation from control: an activated circuit need not control the post-training reward gain. Adapting Metabolic Control Analysis, we define the Post-training Control Coefficient to measure component control over reward gain and arrange these coefficients by task family into a control matrix, paired with an activation-magnitude matrix. We call cross-task control concentration the Shared Control Bottleneck and the difference between activation and control concentration the Activation-Control Gap. This reveals that highly shared activations can coexist with task-specific control, while a small gap indicates that control has collapsed onto a shared direction and lost task specificity. To reduce this collapse, we regularize the post-training loss with the Shared Control Bottleneck and propose Control-Diverse Reinforcement Fine-Tuning (CD-RFT). The exact regularizer gradient requires second-order automatic differentiation incompatible with flash attention, so we derive a first-order proxy with worst-case overhead below eight percent. On Qwen2.5-7B, CD-RFT achieves the largest control decoupling and improves multi-task capability over matched GRPO across mathematics, code, and logic. The no-KL variant leads on pass@1, and the KL-penalized variant leads on large-k pass@k coverage that KL otherwise degrades. Together, these results show that the Shared Control Bottleneck is both a mechanistic diagnostic and a training regularizer, and that control decoupling and capability gains transfer to Llama-3.2-3B.

</details>

<details>

  <summary>Details</summary>

Abstract: Biological neural systems achieve high efficiency and robustness through compartmentalized architectures. In contrast, modern artificial neural networks rely on globally entangled structures, which obscure decision logic and suffer from catastrophic forgetting. Here, we report a Decomposable Spiking Neural Network (D-SNN) that eliminates global synaptic entanglement by structurally isolating classification pathways into independent experts. Optimized via a bio-inspired push-pull loss function, the D-SNN achieves competitive accuracies on MNIST, Fashion-MNIST, and CIFAR-10/100 benchmarks. This modular approach matches the performance of fully dense networks while utilizing an order of magnitude fewer parameters. In addition, our networks operate with up to several orders of magnitude lower firing rates and fewer synaptic operations. Furthermore, physically severing connections between experts provides inherent protection against catastrophic forgetting during sequential learning. Abstract: Permutation optimization arises whenever the components of a system are fixed but their ordering affects performance. We introduce PRISM, a predictive protocol for permutation optimization that measures a fitness landscape before selecting a search strategy. PRISM uses inexpensive landscape diagnostics, including one-step move autocorrelation and fitness-distance correlation, to predict useful mutation operators, identify when structured search is likely to outperform random sampling, and detect regimes in which search provides little advantage. Across synthetic permutation landscapes, neural architecture benchmarks, scientific machine learning pipelines, and large-language-model instruction ordering, the protocol makes testable predictions about search behavior before optimization begins. Exhaustive instruction-ordering experiments reveal substantial performance variation induced solely by permutation, while cross-model experiments show that useful ordering structure can transfer across model families and task difficulty. Additional experiments demonstrate that instruction ordering remains consequential after prompt wording is optimized, indicating that content optimization and ordering optimization are complementary. The results position PRISM not as a universally superior optimizer, but as a framework for determining when permutation search is useful, which representation and operator should be used, and when simpler alternatives are preferable.

</details>

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度神经网络初始化的方式决定了信息与梯度能否在深度方向上传播，但目前缺乏一个统一的理论将这一特性与学习动力学联系起来。作者旨在填补这一空白，建立信息传播与学习动力学之间的理论桥梁。

Method: 本文综合运用平均场理论与随机矩阵理论，研究无限宽、无限深网络的顺序极限。在权重-偏置方差平面中分析相关传播的临界点，通过研究端到端雅可比矩阵的代数衰减来建立NTK与输出相关之间的精确比例关系，并对比高斯初始化与正交初始化下的有限尺寸修正行为。

Result: 相关传播仅在单一临界点可达无限深度；在该点端到端雅可比矩阵随深度代数性消失，且NTK与输出相关在无限深度下恰好成正比。正交初始化能够抑制高斯初始化下的主导有限尺寸修正。所有理论预测在有限宽、有限深网络上通过定量实验得到了定量验证。

Conclusion: 正交初始化在临界状态下对控制深度学习的渐近动力学起着核心作用，该工作首次揭示了信息传播与学习动力学（NTK）之间的等价关系，为理解深度网络初始化的理论角色提供了统一框架。

Abstract: The initialisation of deep neural networks determines whether information and gradients can propagate across depth, yet a unified theory connecting these properties to learning dynamics remains elusive. Combining mean-field theory and random matrix theory, we establish a direct link between correlation propagation and the Neural Tangent Kernel (NTK) that governs learning in the sequential limit of infinitely wide, infinitely deep networks. Correlation propagation to infinite depth is possible only at a single critical point in the weight-bias variance plane. At this point, we show that the end-to-end Jacobian vanishes algebraically with depth, and use this to prove that the NTK becomes exactly proportional to the output correlation at infinite depth. This equivalence between information propagation and learning dynamics had not yet been noticed. We further show that orthogonal initialisation suppresses the leading finite-size corrections present under Gaussian initialisation, clarifying the respective roles of the two initialisation ensembles in this limit. These theoretical predictions are validated quantitatively on finite-width, finite-depth networks. Together, these results demonstrate that orthogonal initialisation at criticality plays a central role in controlling the asymptotic dynamics of deep learning.

</details>


### [68] [Unimodality-Promoting Regularized Learning for Ordinal Regression](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08359)
*Ryoya Yamasaki*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种新的单峰性促进正则化学习（UPRL）方法，纠正了以往UPRL方法在促进条件概率分布(Cpd)单峰性时引入尺度偏差（过于平滑/低置信度）的问题，并通过实验验证了该方法能更严格地反映UPRL思想，提升序数回归的预测性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 序数回归中，真实数据的目标变量条件概率分布（CPD）通常具有单峰性，因此促进预测CPD单峰化有望减少预测方差而不引入过多偏差，尤其在小样本场景下有潜力提升性能。然而以往UPRL方法在促进单峰性的同时会引入"尺度偏差"——即预测分布变得更平滑、更不自信，这偏离了UPRL的初衷。

Method: 1）分析以往UPRL方法，指出其在促进CPD单峰性的同时会使分布尺度变大（更平滑/更不自信）；2）提出一种新的UPRL方法，在促进单峰性的同时避免尺度相关的偏差，更严格地体现UPRL思想；3）通过实验对比验证单峰性促进对预测性能的贡献，并基于尺度偏差的有无解释不同数据规模下性能差异。

Result: 实验对比表明，所提方法能更严格地反映UPRL理念，避免尺度偏差，且单峰性促进确实有助于改善预测性能。此外，与小规模数据或更大训练集下的先前UPRL方法相比，所提方法表现更优或相当，分析表明这种观察可由是否存在意外尺度偏差来解释。

Conclusion: 本文明确了以往UPRL方法中存在的尺度偏差问题，提出更精确的UPRL方法并验证其有效性，同时通过尺度偏差有无的分析框架解释了不同数据规模下新旧方法的性能差异，为序数回归中的单峰性正则化提供了更深入的理解和改进方向。

Abstract: Ordinal regression, also called ordinal classification, is classification of ordinal data, in which the underlying target variable is categorical and considered to have a natural ordinal relation. Previous works have indicated that, in many real-world ordinal data, the conditional probability distribution (CPD) of the target variable given a value of the explanatory variable would be unimodal in a large domain of the explanatory variable and close to be unimodal even in a remaining domain. Therefore, unimodality-promoting regularized learning (UPRL), which promotes a predicted CPD closer to be unimodal with the aim of decreasing a prediction variance without inducing much bias for ordinal data of the unimodality, is promising to improve the prediction performance especially with small-size training data. In this study, we show that previous UPRL methods promote a predicted CPD to not only become closer to be unimodal but also have a larger scale (in other words, be smoother or less-confident). Therefore, we develop a novel method that more strictly reflects the idea of UPRL and evades a scale-related bias, and verify through experimental comparison that the unimodality-promotion indeed contributes to improve the prediction performance. Additionally, while our proposed UPRL method could perform better for smaller-scale data or with larger-size training data compared to a previous UPRL method, our analysis explains this experimental observation in terms of the presence or absence of an unexpected scale-related bias.

</details>


### [69] [Exact Rank and Convex Calibration Dimension Lower Bounds for the Multi-Label F1 Loss](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08399)
*Mingyuan Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文确定了多标签分类中实例级F₁度量损失矩阵的精确秩，并证明其凸校准替代函数的维度为Θ(s²)，填补了之前仅知上下界的空白。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: F₁度量是多标签分类的核心性能指标，其对应的损失矩阵是2^s×2^s的。此前研究已给出该损失矩阵的s²+1坐标仿射表示和移位低秩表示，并据此构造了二次维度的凸校准替代函数，但精确的秩以及凸校准替代函数所需的最小维度仍属未知。本文旨在精确确定这些量。

Method: 本文从三个层面展开：(1) 通过将非空得分矩阵分解为子集关联矩阵与正定Cauchy矩阵的乘积，精确确定F₁得分矩阵、移位损失矩阵和未移位损失矩阵的秩均为s²-s+2，列仿射维度为s²-s+1；(2) 直接分析F₁的贝叶斯几何，构造了一种分布使得恰好某个固定核心标签集的所有超集都是贝叶斯最优的，并计算相应的活跃损失列在见证支撑上的仿射维度为hn（其中n=s-⌊s/3⌋，h=⌈(s⌊s/3⌋)^{1/2}⌉-1）；(3) 利用可行子空间下界证明凸校准维度CCdim(L^{F₁})≥(2/(3√3)-o(1))s²。

Result: 精确确定了F₁相关矩阵的秩为s²-s+2（在约定F₁(∅,∅)=1下），损失矩阵的列仿射维度为s²-s+1。同时证明凸校准维度CCdim(L^{F₁})的下界为(2/(3√3)-o(1))s²，结合已有的二次上界，最终确立CCdim(L^{F₁})=Θ(s²)。

Conclusion: 本文不仅精确刻画了F₁损失矩阵的代数结构（秩和仿射维度），还从贝叶斯几何角度证明了其凸校准替代函数的维度与s²同阶，即线性代数结构与凸校准的几何需求在数量级上是一致的，从而完全确定了F₁度量在凸校准框架下的复杂度特征。

Abstract: The instance-wise $F_1$ measure is a central performance measure for multi-label classification. For a problem with $s$ labels, it defines a $2^s\times 2^s$ loss matrix. Previous work exhibited $s^2+1$-coordinate affine and shifted low-rank representations and used them to construct quadratic-dimensional convex calibrated surrogates. We determine the exact rank. Under the convention $F_1(\varnothing,\varnothing)=1$, the $F_1$ score matrix, the shifted loss matrix, and the unshifted loss matrix all have rank $s^2-s+2$, while the column-affine dimension of the loss is $s^2-s+1$. The proof factors the nonempty score matrix through subset-incidence matrices and a positive-definite Cauchy matrix.

We construct a distribution for which precisely all supersets of a fixed core label set are Bayes optimal, and show that the corresponding active loss columns, restricted to the witness support, have affine dimension $hn$, where $n=s-\lfloor s/3\rfloor$ and $h=\lceil(s\lfloor s/3\rfloor)^{1/2}\rceil-1$. Applying the feasible-subspace lower bound for convex calibration dimension gives \[
  \operatorname{CCdim}(L^{F_1})
  \ge \left(\frac{2}{3\sqrt{3}}-o(1)\right)s^2. \] Together with the quadratic upper bound, this establishes $\operatorname{CCdim}(L^{F_1})=Θ(s^2)$.

Abstract: Existing learning-based influence maximization frameworks rely heavily on complex neural architectures and continuous optimization over seed representations. We challenge this paradigm with SIMBA, a diffusion-model-agnostic framework pairing a lightweight neural surrogate with direct discrete search. SIMBA introduces three key components: 1) uniformly anchored node embeddings that eliminate initialization noise and encourage learning driven by graph topology and diffusion pattern, 2) a shallow two-layer graph neural network surrogate predicting final infection states, and 3) batched multi-swap simulated annealing that explores combinatorial seed space without gradients or continuous relaxation. By shifting compute from complex representation learning to effective discrete search, SIMBA drastically cuts time-to-solution while achieving superior influence spread and data efficiency. Our code is available at https://github.com/yl489/rethink-IM.

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 以往对偶算法在约束学习问题中仅能保证near-PACC（近似约束正确），其不可行性残差无法通过任何数据量消除。本文希望克服这一局限，在完全非凸的无限维假设类中，同时保证最优性和约束满足，实现精确的PACC可学习性。

Method: 方法包含三个核心要素：(1) 将总体问题放置在通用RKHS H_K上（该RKHS在可分解包络中稠密），并在半径渐增的范数球上进行学习；(2) 引入Tikhonov复杂度（达到ε-最优拉格朗日水平集的最小RKHS范数），证明其有限性并获得最优值的精确可学习性；(3) 引入闭包-实现间隙ε*_∞，刻画RKHS通过对偶化检索可行解的能力，以此区分精确可学习（ε*_∞=0，如对偶可微情形）与near-PACC（残差恰为ε*_∞）的情形。

Result: 证明了Tikhonov复杂度有限，在源条件下样本阈值关于1/ε是显式且多项式的；当闭包-实现间隙为零（特别是对偶可微时）获得精确可学习性，否则获得残差恰为该间隙的near-PACC；并证明无约束特化下不存在无分布阈值。

Conclusion: 最优性受限于Rademacher复杂度（偏好小类）与强对偶性（需要可分解性）之间的张力，本文通过通用RKHS上的稠密嵌入和渐增范数球的学习策略调和了二者。不可行性从根本上源自非凸情形下拉格朗日可能不达到其下确界，这一点由闭包-实现间隙这一问题固有属性所刻画。通用性是处理大假设类上对偶算法的本质框架。

Abstract: We study constrained statistical learning over infinite-dimensional hypothesis classes in the fully nonconvex setting, and establish universal PACC learnability of the solutions of dual algorithms: Probably Approximately Correct on Constraints, guaranteeing optimality and constraint satisfaction at once. This strengthens near-PACC results, whose feasibility residual no amount of data can remove. Optimality is caught between generalization, governed by Rademacher complexity and favoring small classes, and strong Lagrangian duality, which rests on Lyapunov convexity for vector measures and needs decomposability, a demand pulling the other way. We reconcile the two by posing the population problem over a universal RKHS $\mathcal{H}_K$, dense in a decomposable envelope, and learning over norm balls of growing radius. This yields the Tikhonov complexity $\mathfrak{T}^{\varepsilon}_{n}$, the least RKHS norm reaching an $\varepsilon$-optimal Lagrangian level set; we prove it finite, obtain exact learnability of the optimal value, and make the sample threshold explicit and polynomial in $1/\varepsilon$ under a source condition. Feasibility is harder: absent convexity the Lagrangian may not attain its infimum, and dual information pins down only an averaged constraint-risk vector, not the risks of any returned predictor. We introduce the closure-realization gap $\varepsilon^\star_\infty$, an index of how well $\mathcal{H}_K$ retrieves feasible solutions from dualization; it is a property of the problem, not of a modeling choice. Learnability is exact when $\varepsilon^\star_\infty=0$, in particular under dual differentiability, and near-PACC with residual exactly $\varepsilon^\star_\infty$ otherwise. Finally, no distribution-free threshold exists already in the unconstrained specialization, so universality is the canonical frame for dual algorithms over large hypothesis classes.

</details>

  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: PAC学习是基础的学习模型，经典模型从可实数设定扩展到允许标签噪声。Tsybakov噪声模型允许决策边界附近的点存在极端噪声，更贴近现实。然而MN06给出的上下界之间相差一个对数因子，这个gap二十年来一直没有被消除。

Result: 将上界改进至与已知最佳下界匹配，从而实现了Tsybakov噪声下PAC学习的最优误差保证，解决了这一二十年的开放问题。

Conclusion: 通过创新的自适应分区技术，本文在Tsybakov噪声学习问题上取得了紧的误差界，填补了长期存在的研究空白，并为非实数学习提供了新的理论工具。

Abstract: Probably Approximately Correct (PAC) learning [Val84] is a fundamental learning model that has been extensively investigated. In this model, $\mathcal{H} \subseteq \{0,1\}^{\mathcal{X}}$ is a concept class, and $h^*\in\mathcal{H}$ is the target concept to be learned. Having access to i.i.d. labeled examples from a distribution $\mathcal{D}$ over $\mathcal{X}\times\{0,1\}$, which admits $h^*$ as the best concept in $\mathcal{H}$, the goal is to design a learning algorithm that outputs a hypothesis having low error competitive to $h^{*}$ with high probability.
  This model was initially studied under the realizable setting, which assumes that $h^*$ has no error. A natural relaxation is to allow label noise, that is, the true label can be flipped with probability $η\in(0,1/2)$. In reality, certain labels might be extremely noisy, especially for those points near the decision boundary. Hence, it is natural to allow very noisy points, though only rarely. This is quantified by a noise model introduced by [MT99] and [Tsy04], now known as Tsybakov noise. For learning general concept classes, [MN06] gave the general upper and lower bounds for error guarantees under Tsybakov noise. However, their upper and lower bounds differ by a logarithmic factor. Resolving this gap has remained a well-known open question for the past twenty years.
  In this work, we resolve this open question by improving the upper bound to match the best known lower bound, thus establishing the optimal error guarantee for learning under Tsybakov noise. Our learning algorithm operates by adaptively partitioning the instance space into regions, roughly corresponding to different noise levels, and returning a hypothesis in the concept class satisfying a specific error constraint for each region. Our technique shares a conceptual foundation with several recent advances in non-realizable learning, such as [HLZ24] and [Han25].

</details>

Abstract: Heterogeneous RF sensing differs substantially in feature structure, spatial layout, and temporal scale, making existing models difficult to reuse across devices, environments, and RF modalities. We propose FSTC-Encoder, which unifies heterogeneous RF representation learning through feature, spatial, and temporal correlation modeling. Structure-aware feature encoding accommodates different signal structures, set-based spatial encoding aggregates variable observations, and hierarchical temporal encoding jointly captures local variations and long-range dependencies. Across sensing tasks and modalities, FSTC-Encoder retains the same spatial--temporal backbone architecture while varying only the feature configuration and task head. Across Widar3.0, CSI-Bench, and XRF55, FSTC-Encoder achieves 92.15% mean Accuracy under multi-factor cross-domain protocols, ranks first on three of four additional sensing tasks, remains consistently strong across WiFi, millimeter-wave radar, and RFID, and reduces the cross-modality performance gap from 18.85% to 12.93% through cross-RF learning. These results demonstrate that FSTC-Encoder achieves high domain robustness, task generality, and modality extensibility.

*Xiang Xie*

  <summary>Details</summary>

Abstract: Cross-subject electroencephalogram (EEG)-based emotion recognition remains challenging due to substantial inter-individual variability and discrete formulation that overlooks affective continuity. This article proposes MGMCL, reconceptualizing emotion recognition as learning continuous representations on symmetric positive definite (SPD) Riemannian manifolds. The frame?work introduces multi-granularity manifold contrastive learning at instance, emotion, and trajectory levels while preserving semantic ordering. Neural ordinary differential equations on manifolds model continuous emotion dynamics. Cross-subject generalization employs Gromov-Wasserstein manifold alignment. Weakly-supervised learning enables continuous valence-arousal-dominance prediction from discrete labels. Extensive experiments on three public datasets demonstrate state-of-the-art performance: 91.23% accuracy on SEED, 73.82% on SEED-IV, and 76.38% on DEAP, achieving consistent improvements of 1.89%, 1.66%, and 1.28% over previous best methods, respectively.

Abstract: Federated Learning is a distributed machine learning paradigm that trains a global model by aggregating local clients without sharing private data of each client. *Srinivasan Manoharan,Junhua Zhao,Fangbo Tu,Haifeng Wu,Jian Wan,Maliah Rajan M,Ashwin Hegde,Mithun Sasidharan,Kalyan Chakravarthi Podamekala*

TL;DR: 本文提出T2MO（Task-to-Model Optimization），一种面向企业AI编程助手生产环境的、数据驱动的模型选择优化方法论。它将每个开发者会话视为一个可被发现、分类、评分、基准测试并路由到最便宜合格模型的任务，目标是最小化每个已完成任务的期望成本（含失败升级成本），而非单纯最小化token成本，并通过九阶段流水线和两级决策层级实现生产部署。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 企业AI编程助手产生大量推理开销，而朴素的token成本最小化方法在实际生产中往往会因重试、升级（escalation）和开发者等待时间而被抵消，导致端到端成本并未真正降低。因此需要一种能够将失败升级成本显式纳入考量、以"每完成任务的成本"为目标的模型路由优化方法。

Method: T2MO将每个开发者会话视为一个任务，通过九阶段流水线处理：遥测采集、分类学发现、难度分级、基准构建、候选模型评估、最优模型组合推导、预测与版本规划、分阶段路由部署、持续治理。核心目标函数是期望完成成本（expected completion cost），并推导了路由边界和更便宜模型所需达到的最低通过率。决策采用两级层级（任务类别×难度层级），单元级（cell-level）替代机会聚合并按流量加权生成节省瀑布（savings waterfall），按实际美元影响对候选模型排序。部署路径从静态策略逐步过渡到影子模式分类器、验证级联，最终到智能路由器。

Result: 论文从理论上证明了在存在升级机制的条件下，期望完成成本目标弱支配token成本最小化目标，并推导出路由边界条件（即更便宜模型在特定单元格上达到的最低通过率阈值）。框架支持开发者指导、支出预测，以及从静态策略到影子模式、验证级联直至智能路由器的分阶段部署。

Conclusion: T2MO为生产环境中的AI编程助手提供了一套可落地的模型选择优化方法论，其核心贡献在于将成本度量从token层面提升到任务完成层面，并给出了完整的评估协议和治理闭环。该框架以适合生产部署和未来实证研究的形式呈现，为后续实验验证奠定了基础。

Abstract: Enterprise AI coding assistants incur substantial inference spend, and naive token-cost minimization often fails to reduce end-to-end cost once retries, escalations, and developer wait time are included. We present Task-to-Model Optimization (T2MO), a data-driven methodology for optimizing model selection in production coding workflows. We treat each developer session as a task that can be discovered, classified, graded for difficulty, benchmarked in a production-like harness, and routed to the cheapest model able to complete it within quality and latency constraints. The framework is a nine-stage pipeline spanning telemetry instrumentation, taxonomy discovery, difficulty grading, benchmark construction, candidate evaluation, optimal mix derivation, forecasting and version planning, staged routing deployment, and continuous governance. Unlike token-centric routing rules, our objective is cost per completed task, with failure escalation priced in explicitly. We show that this expected-completion-cost objective weakly dominates token-cost minimization under escalation, and we derive the routing boundary, the minimum pass rate a cheaper model must reach on a given cell to be worth deploying. Decisions are organized as a two-level hierarchy of task category difficulty tier, and per-cell displacement opportunities are aggregated into a traffic-weighted savings waterfall that ranks replacement candidates by realized dollar impact. The framework supports developer guidance, spend forecasting, and a staged transition from static policies to shadow-mode classifiers, verified cascades, and ultimately an intelligent router. We describe the methodology, optimization objective, evaluation protocol, and governance loop in a form suitable for production deployment and future empirical study.

</details>

Abstract: Circuit localization is a mechanistic interpretability task whose goal is to identify a sparse subgraph of a transformer's computation graph sufficient to reproduce a particular behavior. Most established methods localize circuits independently for each model--task pair. We instead frame circuit localization as a graph machine learning problem in which the edges of a computation graph represent computational pathways, and graph neural networks (GNNs) model interactions among these pathways. We introduce Graph Circuit Learning (GCL), a supervised, amortized framework that trains a GNN across multiple model--task pairs and applies it to unseen cases. To provide sufficient data, we augment the InterpBench benchmark with additional cases derived from the TracrBench programs. Of the 14 evaluated GCL configurations, the highest scored a median edge AUROC of $0.902$ (interquartile interval $[0.861, 0.942]$) on the 16 original held-out InterpBench cases. This is close to the published InterpBench median of $0.910$ for EAP-IG while remaining below ACDC's $0.959$. Removing all message-passing edges reduces the median to $0.825$. We also adapt PGExplainer, a GNN explainability method, to circuit localization, obtaining a median edge AUROC of $0.858$ on the same cases. These preliminary results suggest that graph machine learning offers a natural and potentially powerful perspective on circuit localization, and we hope this perspective encourages closer exchange between the two communities.

</details>


### [79] [When Skills Meet Safety: Benchmarking and Characterizing the Adaptive Jailbreak Robustness of Skill-Merged LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08542)
*Yu Ma,Hongli Shi,Jing Li,Xinran Xu,Weiwei Hou*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出SkillSafe-Bench基准，揭示静态拒绝测试无法预测技能合并模型的安全性——因安全对齐是"浅层"的（集中在前几个生成token），静态看起来安全的合并模型在面对自适应攻击时仍可能被越狱。研究基于六个开源基座模型，发现静态安全性与攻击鲁棒性无相关性，并提出数据无关的几何信号（任务向量与安全子空间的重叠）来刻画安全侵蚀，以及SubSafe-Merge方法通过投影去除该侵蚀。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 模型合并（如task arithmetic、TIES、DARE）已成为给已对齐模型添加新技能的默认方式，但其安全代价的现有证据几乎全部依赖静态拒绝测试（固定有害提示的合规评分）。作者认为这是误导性的：因为安全对齐是"浅层"的，集中在生成的前几个token，合并模型的静态拒绝可能看起来正常，但真实的自适应攻击仍能攻破它。因此需要更可靠的安全评估方法。

Method: 1) 提出SkillSafe-Bench基准，用保守的双法官AND规则评估技能合并模型的三个方面：静态拒绝、自适应越狱鲁棒性和能力保持。2) 在六个开源基座（Qwen两个规模、Gemma、Llama、Phi-4）上进行系统评估，使用语义模板攻击测试自适应健壮性。3) 通过数据无关的几何信号——任务向量与安全子空间的重叠——刻画与abliteration风格相同的安全侵蚀。4) 提出SubSafe-Merge方法，将任务向量在安全子空间上的重叠投影移除，在保持能力的同时消除安全侵蚀。

Result: 静态安全性与攻击鲁棒性不相关：在语义模板攻击下，脆弱基座（Qwen两个规模及Gemma）上看似安全的合并模型被越狱率达60-76%，而Llama和Phi-4保持鲁棒。合并的静态安全效应是基座条件依赖的；同配方下安全侵蚀可通过任务向量与安全子空间重叠这一数据无关几何信号刻画；SubSafe-Merge通过投影去除重叠可以在保持能力的同时消除安全侵蚀。

Conclusion: 对合并LLM而言，自适应评估不是可选项：最需要评估的模型在静态筛选下看起来是安全的。安全对齐的"浅层"特性要求对模型合并的安全评估超越静态拒绝测试，采用自适应攻击来揭示真实风险。

Abstract: Model merging has become the default way to give an aligned language model new skills without retraining: a practitioner folds task vectors from math, code, or domain specialists into a safety-aligned base using task arithmetic, TIES, or DARE. This convenience is known to carry a safety cost, but almost all of that evidence rests on static refusal tests: fixed harmful prompts scored for compliance. We argue this is misleading. Because safety alignment is "shallow," concentrated in the first few generated tokens, a merged model's static refusal can stay clean while a real adaptive attack still breaks it. We introduce SkillSafe-Bench, a controlled benchmark that scores skill-merged models on static refusal, adaptive jailbreak robustness, and capability retention under a conservative two-judge AND rule. Across six open-weight bases (five families, two scales), static safety does not predict robustness to attack: under a semantic template attack, safe-looking merges on the fragile bases (both Qwen scales and Gemma) are jailbroken 60-76% of the time while others (Llama, Phi-4) stay robust. We further show the static effect of merging is base-conditional, characterize same-recipe abliteration-style safety erosion through a data-free geometric signal (the overlap of a task vector with a safety subspace), and outline SubSafe-Merge, which projects this overlap away to remove that erosion at held capability. Adaptive evaluation is not optional for merged LLMs: the models that most need it look safe under static screening.

</details>


### [80] [Neural Message Passing on Structural Interaction Graphs for Fully-Inductive Graph Neural Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08567)
*Omer Yom Tov,Avigdor Gal*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: SIGIL是一个统一的图基础模型框架，通过将任意属性图映射到固定维度的统一表示空间，解决图基础模型中的输入异质性（特征维度、语义、结构）挑战，实现跨图的可迁移性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 图基础模型的核心障碍是输入异质性——不同图的特征空间维度、语义和结构各不相同，这限制了图神经网络泛化到具有未见特征空间的新图的能力。现有方法难以在不同图之间实现知识迁移。

Method: SIGIL将任意属性图提升为结构交互图（structural interaction graph），其中节点为输入特征维度，加权且有类型的边编码跨图连接多阶的图连接性的特征对齐。然后使用关系消息传递网络将每个特征维度嵌入到共享空间，将任意维度的原始节点特征转换为可迁移到任何下游图的表示。该框架对节点、特征维度和标签的置换具有等变性。

Result: 单个SIGIL模型在仅于一个图上预训练后，即可在完全归纳式（fully-inductive）链接预测任务上表现优异。此外，当输入特征为离散关系的一热指示器时，SIGIL可以恢复并严格泛化现有的知识图谱推理基础模型，也可用于实现现有的知识图谱基础模型。

Conclusion: SIGIL将图基础模型设计中的多种现有范式统一在一个单一框架之下，为图基础模型的跨图泛化和可迁移性提供了统一的理论与实践基础。

Abstract: A central obstacle in building graph foundation models is the input heterogeneity in terms of feature space dimensionality, semantics, and structure. Such heterogeneity limits the capability of graph neural networks to generalize to new graphs with unseen feature spaces. We address the transferability challenge with SIGIL, a framework that maps any attributed graph to a unified representation space of fixed dimension. Given a graph, SIGIL lifts it to a structural interaction graph, where nodes are the input feature dimensions and weighted, typed edges encode feature alignment across multiple orders of the graph's connectivity. A relational message-passing network embeds each feature dimension into a shared space, transforming the original node features, of arbitrary dimensionality, into representations transferable to any downstream graph. By construction, SIGIL is equivariant to permutations of nodes, feature dimensions, and labels. Additionally, when the input features are one-hot indicators of discrete relations, SIGIL recovers and strictly generalizes existing foundation models for knowledge graph reasoning. A single SIGIL model, pretrained on one graph, delivers strong fully-inductive link prediction. Also, SIGIL can be used to implement existing knowledge graph foundation models. As such, SIGIL unifies several existing regimes in graph foundation model design under a single framework

</details>

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 欺诈运营需要在自动批准、分析师审查和自动拦截之间分配事件，但评估这些行动所需的标签是有选择性的且延迟的。现有的预测评分只能对案例排序，无法判断证据是否足够新且具有代表性来将行动委托给模型，因此需要一种决策支持框架来约束自动化决策。

Method: 提出新鲜度约束审计容量（FCAC）框架，将自动化视为受行动风险、证据新鲜度和共享审核容量约束的授权决策。该框架从成熟的随机审计和预设的时间容差中评估候选行动区域，支持的区域被自动化，不支持的保留在审核中。在代表性随机审计、标签无关证据窗口和预设条件（关联历史与当前行动风险）下，推导出对不安全授权的同步有限样本控制。

Result: 在IEEE-CIS、ULB-Worldline和Elliptic++上使用模拟审计进行时间序贯评估，得到零漂移自动化率分别为84.4%、67.4%和81.3%，总审核工作量为24.1%、46.0%和43.1%。实验揭示审计-容量权衡：稀疏审计延迟授权，密集审计最终增加工作量。BAF压力测试表明回退阈值应反映候选特定证据而非风险限制的公共分数。

Conclusion: 审计新鲜度和分析师容量是欺诈决策支持的联合设计考量。当前行动风险在未限制未观察标签演化的情况下是无法识别的，而FCAC框架为这一问题提供了可操作的控制方案。

Abstract: Fraud operations must allocate events among automatic approval, analyst review, and automatic blocking even though the labels needed to evaluate these actions are selective and delayed. Predictive scores order cases, but they do not show whether the evidence is current and representative enough to delegate an action to the model. We develop freshness-constrained audit capacity (FCAC), a decision-support framework that treats automation as an authorization decision constrained by action risk, evidence freshness, and shared review capacity. It evaluates candidate action regions from mature randomized audits and a prespecified temporal allowance. Supported regions are automated; unsupported regions remain in review. The resulting decision record reports evidence age, audit demand, total review workload, value exposure, and compatible temporal change. We show that current action risk is unidentified without restricting unobserved label evolution. Under representative randomized audits, label-independent evidence windows, and a prespecified condition linking historical and current action risk, we derive simultaneous finite-sample control of unsafe authorization. Chronological evaluations with simulated audits on IEEE-CIS, ULB-Worldline, and Elliptic++ yield zero-drift automation rates of 84.4%, 67.4%, and 81.3%, with total review workloads of 24.1%, 46.0%, and 43.1%. The experiments reveal an audit-capacity trade-off: sparse auditing delays authorization, whereas intensive auditing eventually increases workload. A separately specified BAF stress test further indicates that fallback thresholds must reflect candidate-specific evidence rather than a common fraction of the risk limit. These findings identify audit freshness and analyst capacity as joint design considerations for fraud decision support.

</details>

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多智能体强化学习依赖精心设计的全局奖励函数，但在异构智能体系统中，单一标量目标难以捕捉多样化行为，精确设计奖励既困难又不切实际。

Method: MAGPIE为每个智能体分配专属专家评估者，通过偏好信号进行去中心化评估；从偏好数据构建智能体专属奖励模型，并通过单调聚合机制将其组合为全局目标；理论证明优化该聚合奖励等价于训练纳什均衡策略。

Abstract: Multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) is a powerful framework for solving complex collaborative tasks, but it relies heavily on well-defined global reward functions. Designing such rewards is challenging, especially in systems with heterogeneous agents, where a single scalar objective may fail to capture diverse behaviors. In this paper, we introduce Multi-AGent Preference-Integrated lEarning (MAGPIE), which addresses these challenges through agent-specific preference modeling. Each agent is evaluated by a dedicated expert through preference signals, eliminating the need for global evaluation. We theoretically prove that optimizing these decentralized preferences converges to a Nash equilibrium policy. To integrate local preferences into a coherent global objective, we construct agent-specific reward models from preference data and combine them via a monotonic aggregation mechanism. We further prove that optimizing this aggregate reward model is equivalent to training the Nash equilibrium policy. Extensive experiments on benchmark multi-agent tasks and a sequential production line task show that MAGPIE achieves performance comparable to reward-engineered baselines, demonstrating its potential to facilitate policy learning in scenarios where precise reward engineering is impractical.

</details>


### [83] [Domain-Aware Pruning: Sparsity and Domain Generalization via Regularized Probabilistic Masking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08624)
*Parham Sazdar,Mostafa Tavassolipour,Reshad Hosseini*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出域感知剪枝（DAP）框架，通过将网络剪枝建模为连续概率掩码优化问题，在压缩模型的同时隐式增强其域泛化能力，在五个DG基准上实现高稀疏度并匹配或超越稠密模型的OOD性能，且无需后处理微调。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 域泛化和神经网络剪枝传统上被视为两个独立的目标，分别致力于OOD鲁棒性和模型效率。本文旨在弥合这一鸿沟，探索利用网络稀疏性作为隐式增强对未见域泛化能力的机制，而非将两者割裂处理。

Method: DAP将网络压缩定义为连续概率掩码问题，学习参数保留概率p∈[0,1]而非标准二值掩码。在掩码训练过程中引入正则化目标，主动惩罚对域敏感权重的保留，从而识别出域不变的子网络。该框架是算法无关的，可无缝集成到现有DG流水线中。

Result: 在五个DG基准数据集上的实验表明，DAP在实现显著稀疏度的同时，一致匹配或超越了稠密对应模型的OOD性能。此外，DAP原生提供了对对抗扰动的增强鲁棒性，并产生高度可解释的模型，保留的权重可靠地封装了最域不变和任务关键的表示。

Conclusion: DAP证明了剪枝与域泛化可以协同而非对立，网络稀疏性本身可作为提升OOD鲁棒性的有效机制。该方法兼具效率、泛化、鲁棒性和可解释性，且无需后处理微调，为DG与模型压缩的交叉研究提供了新方向。

Abstract: Domain generalization (DG) and neural network pruning are conventionally treated as distinct objectives, targeting out-of-distribution (OOD) robustness and model efficiency, respectively. In this work, we bridge this gap by introducing Domain-Aware Pruning (DAP), a framework that leverages network sparsity as a mechanism to implicitly enhance generalization to unseen domains. Diverging from standard binary mask optimization, DAP learns a continuous parameter retention probability $p \in [0, 1]$, framing network compression as a continuous probabilistic masking problem. By introducing a regularization objective that actively penalizes the retention of domain-sensitive weights during the mask training, DAP identifies a domain-invariant subnetwork. Empirical results across five DG benchmark datasets demonstrate that DAP achieves significant sparsity while consistently matching or exceeding the OOD performance of its dense counterparts. Crucially, DAP is an algorithm-agnostic framework that integrates seamlessly with existing DG pipelines without necessitating post-hoc fine-tuning. Beyond efficiency and generalization, we show that DAP natively provides increased robustness to adversarial perturbations and yields highly interpretable models, where the retained weights reliably encapsulate the most domain-invariant and task-critical representations.

</details>


### [84] [Trajectory Design and Budgeted Querying for Digital Twin Calibration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08631)
*Vladyslava Spitkovska,Dmytro Kuzmenko*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究数字孪生标定中数据采集的两个决策问题：轨迹生成与稀缺特权参数测量预算分配。提出耦合激励导向强化学习控制器、带预测不确定性的循环参数估计器和预算化查询策略的框架，并在Pendulum和Waterworld两种环境中展示该方法在数据稀缺条件下显著优于未标定孪生系统。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 数字孪生标定需要交互数据，但此类数据采集成本高昂。现有方法通常假设可以收集足够多的任务导向数据，但现实场景中数据稀缺，且需要在轨迹生成方式和特权参数测量预算分配之间做出权衡。这两个决策问题尚未被系统研究。

Method: 提出一个三模块耦合框架：(1) 激励导向的强化学习控制器用于生成有利于参数估计的轨迹；(2) 带预测不确定性的循环（GRU）参数估计器；(3) 预算化的查询策略用于决定何时消耗有限的特权参数测量预算。在Pendulum中比较随机森林与GRU的诊断能力，并测试部分撤回连续oracle访问的效果；在部分可观测的Waterworld中测试多控制器混合训练。

Result: Pendulum中，GRU在激励导向轨迹上训练后无需查询即可达到0.0066的MAE，而随机森林在任务导向轨迹上只能弱恢复重力且无法恢复质量和长度。在三查询预算下，估计器加策略管线达到0.0092的终端误差，远优于未标定孪生的0.2031。Waterworld中，五控制器混合训练的估计器达到约4-5%的在线归一化误差。

Conclusion: 虽然这些探索性案例研究并非受控消融实验，但结果强有力地表明，在数据稀缺的标定场景中，应把轨迹设计和查询分配视作显式的设计变量而非默认假设，这为未来在更广泛场景中的系统研究提供了动机和基础。

Abstract: Digital-twin calibration requires interaction data that is expensive to collect. We study two acquisition decisions: which trajectories to generate, and when to spend a limited budget on privileged parameter measurements. Our framework couples an excitation-oriented reinforcement learning controller, a recurrent parameter estimator with predictive uncertainty, and a budgeted query policy. In Pendulum, a Random Forest diagnostic recovers gravity only weakly from task-oriented trajectories and does not recover mass or length, while a GRU trained on excitation-oriented trajectories reaches a mean absolute error of 0.0066 with no queries. We then withdraw continuous oracle access partway through an episode, so that the twin must run on the estimator's output for the remainder. The estimator-plus-policy pipeline achieves a terminal error of 0.0092 under a three-query budget, against 0.2031 for an uncalibrated twin. In partially observable Waterworld, five controllers produce different observed error profiles across three hidden parameters, and an estimator trained on a five-controller mixture reaches online normalized errors of roughly 4-5%. These exploratory case studies are not controlled ablations, but they motivate treating trajectory design and query allocation as explicit design variables in data-scarce calibration.

</details>


### [85] [Exact Rank-Space KL Projection for Shared-Marginal Low-Rank Factors: Application to Doubly Stochastic Clustering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08642)
*Enliang Hu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究低秩分解的精确KL投影问题，将带行边际约束和共享列边际的双非负因子分解的联合KL投影化简为仅含r-1个有效变量的严格凸规范固定对偶问题，并将其应用于学习精确双随机图，在保持可行性的同时实现高效率的镜像下降优化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 低秩非负因子分解与KL投影在诸多应用中至关重要，但联合约束下的精确KL投影通常计算复杂且缺乏结构化的几何性质。此外，学习精确双随机（DS）图需要优化n×n变量，成本高昂且难以保证可行性。

Method: 将两个非负因子的联合KL投影通过规范固定（gauge-fixing）化简为严格凸的r-1维对偶问题，其Hessian为分类协方差项之和，支持O((n+m)r)的矩阵无关Hessian-向量积。将几何专门化为DS图学习，采用行单纯形因子加公共列质量诱导精确DS图，结合稀疏边拟合、锚点约简流形正则化器与Bregman回溯的镜像下降方法。

Result: 在非消失潜在质量条件下，方法满足充分下降性质与O(1/N)的镜像驻点界，严格正聚点达到KKT驻点。匹配聚类实验展示竞争性精度、可行残差接近数值精度，且不产生稠密学习图的情况下有良好的anytime行为。

Conclusion: 该工作在理论上将KL投影化简到极低维度并提供高效Hessian运算，在算法上实现了每一步都精确可行且收敛有保证的双随机图学习方法，避免了显式构造n×n稠密矩阵的计算开销。

Abstract: We study exact Kullback--Leibler (KL) projection for low-rank factorizations whose two nonnegative factors have prescribed row marginals and a shared, learned column marginal. For arbitrary positive row marginals of equal total mass, the joint KL projection reduces exactly to a strictly convex gauge-fixed dual with only $r-1$ effective variables; its Hessian is a sum of categorical covariance terms and admits $O((n+m)r)$ matrix-free Hessian--vector products. The projection theorem is objective-independent. We then specialize this geometry to doubly stochastic (DS) graph learning through $W=U\operatorname{Diag}(g)^{-1}V^\top$, where row-simplex factors with a common column mass induce an exactly DS graph without materializing an $n\times n$ optimization variable. Combined with observed-edge sparse fitting, a stochastic anchor-reduced manifold regularizer, and Bregman backtracking, the resulting mirror-descent method preserves exact feasibility at every accepted step. Under a nonvanishing latent-mass condition, it satisfies sufficient decrease and an $O(1/N)$ mirror-stationarity bound, while strictly positive accumulation points are KKT stationary. Matched clustering experiments show competitive accuracy, feasibility residuals near numerical precision, and favorable anytime behavior without a dense learned graph.

</details>


### [86] [Path-dependent Discrete Amortized Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08644)
*Tiago da Silva,Esmeralda S. Whitammer,Salem Lahlou*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种路径依赖的离散摊销推断方法，通过引入可学习的隐变量动态系统来替代马尔可夫决策过程（MDP）假设，使策略能够依赖整个历史轨迹而非仅当前状态，从而解决信号传播受阻和状态别名的表达力问题，并在标准基准上实现了更快的收敛速度和更好的状态空间探索。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法将组合离散对象的采样问题建模为确定性马尔可夫决策过程（MDP），逐步构建对象以匹配后验分布。但作者指出马尔可夫假设存在两个关键缺陷：(1) 训练时阻碍信号在时间步之间的传播；(2) 由于状态别名（state aliasing）问题，严重削弱了学习到的采样器的表达能力。

Method: 作者提出将MDP提升为带可学习隐变量动态系统的框架，使底层策略能够依赖完整的过去轨迹（即路径依赖）而非仅当前状态，从而克服马尔可夫假设的限制。同时，作者为这一新的设置给出了已有离散摊销采样器学习算法的理论扩展（可证明的有效性）。

Result: 在标准基准问题上，该方法相比先前的技术通常实现了更快的训练收敛速度以及改进的状态空间探索能力。

Conclusion: 通过放宽马尔可夫假设、引入路径依赖的隐动态系统，所提方法在理论和实验层面均有效缓解了现有离散摊销采样器在信号传播与表达能力上的不足，为组合离散对象的摊销推断提供了更优的解决方案。

Abstract: We consider the problem of sampling compositional and discrete objects from a given unnormalized posterior distribution. Notably, recent studies have shown that this problem can be efficiently solved by learning a deterministic Markov Decision Process (MDP) that progressively builds each object in proportion to the posterior. In this work, however, we demonstrate that the Markovian assumption can both hamper signal propagation during training and catastrophically reduce the learned sampler's expressivity due to state aliasing. To address these issues, we propose lifting the MDP with a learnable latent dynamical system that allows the underlying policy to depend on the entire past trajectory---and not only on the current state. In view of this, we refer to the resulting method as path-dependent discrete amortized inference. Importantly, we provably extend existing learning algorithms for discrete amortized samplers to our setting. In experiments on standard benchmark problems, we also show that our approach often leads to faster learning convergence and improved state space exploration relatively to prior techniques.

</details>


### [87] [Multi-Relational Knowledge Graph Enhanced Embedding for Trajectory-User Linking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08646)
*Zhifeng Chu,Bin Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出MakeTUL，首个将知识图谱表示学习引入轨迹-用户链接（TUL）任务的方法，通过多关系移动知识图谱整合访问时间、POI类别和转移速度等异构移动语义，并结合高阶共现模式增强轨迹表示，最终通过双分支分类层在决策层面融合全局结构与顺序证据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有TUL方法存在三个主要问题：1）通常独立学习POI、时间和语义特征，忽略它们之间的相互约束；2）对轨迹间共享的结构知识利用有限；3）在分类前过早压缩结构和顺序信息，导致信息丢失。这些缺陷在轨迹稀疏和重叠的场景下尤为突出。

Method: MakeTUL包含三个核心组件：1）多关系移动知识图谱构建——将访问时间、POI类别和转移速度编码为类型化关系，通过知识图谱表示学习使异构移动语义联合约束嵌入；2）高阶共现模式提取——从轨迹集合中挖掘POI的高阶共现模式，为稀疏和重叠轨迹提供结构先验知识；3）双分支分类层——轨迹序列学习模块捕捉有序移动模式，同时双分支结构在决策层面分别保留并融合全局结构证据与顺序证据。

Result: MakeTUL在轨迹-用户链接任务上取得了优于现有方法的性能，尤其是在轨迹稀疏和重叠的场景下，通过结构先验知识有效提升了链接准确性。

Conclusion: MakeTUL证明了知识图谱表示学习与TUL结合的有效性，通过多关系语义联合约束和高阶结构先验增强，解决了现有方法在特征独立学习、结构知识利用不足和信息过早压缩等方面的问题。

Abstract: Trajectory-User Linking (TUL) aims to identify the owner of an anonymous trajectory from a set of candidate users, providing a basis for user mobility analysis and personalized location-aware services. Existing methods often learn Point of Interest (POI), temporal, and semantic features independently, make limited use of structural knowledge shared across trajectories, and compress structural and sequential information before classification. To address these issues, we propose Multi-Relational Knowledge Graph Enhanced Embedding for Trajectory-User Linking (MakeTUL), which, to the best of our knowledge, is the first attempt to introduce knowledge graph representation learning into TUL. MakeTUL organizes visit-time, POI-category, and transfer-speed information as typed relations in a multi-relational mobility knowledge graph, allowing heterogeneous mobility semantics to jointly constrain the learned embeddings. The resulting POI representations are further enriched with high-order co-occurrence patterns extracted from the trajectory collection, providing structural prior knowledge for sparse and overlapping trajectories. By integrating these prior-enhanced representations with temporal, category, and transfer information, the trajectory sequence learning module captures ordered mobility patterns, while a dual-branch classification layer preserves and combines global structural evidence and sequential evidence at the decision level.

</details>


### [88] [LegoLM: Structured Weight Sharing for Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08652)
*Joseph Bingham*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: LegoLM是一个面向大语言模型的结构化权重共享压缩框架，通过识别并解决全局权重共享的两种失败模式（分布失配和异常值主导），采用三种无数据自适应方法（标量块编码、百分位选择性替换、边界层保护），在Mistral-7B上实现4.41X压缩仅增加0.03%困惑度，并在5.12X压缩下保持下游任务精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 全局权重共享（如K-means聚类压缩）在大语言模型中表现不佳，作者系统性研究其失败原因，发现两种截然不同的失败模式：对于小维度（d≤2）向量块的分布失配问题，以及对于标量块的异常值主导问题。理解并解决这两种机制是实现高质量权重共享压缩的必要前提。

Method: LegoLM包含三种无数据自适应方法：(1) 标量块编码，消除与维度d线性相关的失配分量；(2) 百分位选择性替换，识别并逐字保留异常值权重；(3) 边界层保护，保护第一层和最后一层Transformer块。这些方法共同解决了分布失配和异常值主导两种失败模式。

Result: 在GPT-2 small (124M)和Mistral-7B上验证：LegoLM在Mistral-7B上实现4.41X压缩仅+0.03% PPL退化（优于PTQ-8bit），2.67X压缩时PPL为-0.02%。K=64、p=99%时在5.12X压缩下LAMBADA和HellaSwag精度保持噪声级。研究发现异常值主导随模型规模增长：K=128完全替换使Mistral-7B退化1,134,279%，而选择性替换(p=99%)将两个模型控制在+15%以内。消融实验证实选择性替换是主导机制，加入该机制后逐层K-means也达到近无损质量。

Conclusion: LegoLM通过精确诊断权重共享的两种失败机制并针对性设计修复方案，实现了超越PTQ-8bit的压缩质量和压缩比。其核心洞察是：异常值主导问题随模型规模呈灾难性增长趋势，选择性替换是解决该问题的关键机制，这不仅为LegoLM本身提供了理论基础，也揭示了逐层K-means方法效果不佳的深层原因。

Abstract: We present \LegoLM{}, a structured weight-sharing compression framework for large language models grounded in a systematic study of why global weight sharing fails and how to fix it. We identify two distinct failure modes. Distributional mismatch: for vector blocks of dimension d <= 2, transformer layers with heterogeneous weight scales impose a scale-mismatch penalty that grows linearly with d and cannot be resolved by increasing K, producing perplexity in the millions.Outlier dominance: for scalar blocks, a fraction ~1/K of weights lies beyond the outermost Lloyd-Max decision threshold and cannot be represented by any centroid; their misrepresentation accumulates across layers, causing catastrophic quality loss. \LegoLM{} resolves both failure modes via three data-free adaptations: 1 scalar-block encoding to eliminate the $d$-linear mismatch component, 2 percentile-selective replacement that identifies and preserves outlier weights verbatim, and 3 boundary-layer protection for the first and last transformer blocks. Across GPT-2 small (124M) and Mistral-7B, \LegoLM{} achieves +0.03% PPL degradation at 4.41X compression on Mistral-7B - outperforming PTQ-8bit in both quality and compression ratio - and -0.02% at 2.67X. Downstream evaluation on LAMBADA and HellaSwag confirms that \LegoLM{} at K=64, p=99% preserves accuracy within noise at 5.12 X compression, exceeding PTQ-8bit's compression ratio while matching its accuracy. We further discover that outlier dominance grows with model scale: full replacement at K=128 degrades GPT-2 small by only +23% but catastrophically degrades Mistral-7B by +1,134,279%, while selective replacement at p=99% rescues both models to under +15%. A controlled ablation confirms that selective replacement is the dominant mechanism: adding it to per-layer K-means also yields near-lossless quality, matching \LegoLM{} within 0.02%.

</details>


### [89] [Catastrophic Forgetting in Continual Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08673)
*Emma Graham*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文探索强化学习中任务相似性与灾难性遗忘之间的关系，使用Q-learning在基于图的任务上进行实验，结果发现任务相似性与遗忘之间存在复杂动态，且未发现任务相似性对遗忘具有独立统计显著影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 灾难性遗忘是持续学习中的重大障碍，理解新任务相似性如何影响旧任务性能对于设计更好的持续学习算法至关重要。当前对任务相似性与遗忘之间关系缺乏系统性理解。

Method: 采用可解释的强化学习方法（Q-learning），在基于图的任务上进行实验，以最小化到达目标的步数为目标。设计了不同相对复杂度水平的任务，训练新任务后评估旧任务上的表现，系统考察任务相似性与遗忘严重程度的关系。

Result: 实验结果揭示了任务相似性与遗忘之间复杂的动态关系，遗忘严重程度在不同任务相似度和复杂度水平上出现显著波动，伴随高变异性。未发现任务相似性独立对遗忘产生统计显著影响的证据，且任务相似度测量分布不均匀。

Conclusion: 任务相似性与灾难性遗忘之间的关系仍不明确，两者可能相互依赖并受任务复杂度影响。需要进一步研究以全面理解任务相似性与灾难性遗忘之间的潜在相互作用。

Abstract: This work explores the relationship between task similarity and catastrophic forgetting in reinforcement learning. Catastrophic forgetting, the phenomenon in machine learning of losing the ability to effectively perform on previous tasks, is a significant impediment to continual learning. This study aims to understand the extent to which the similarity of a new task influences the performance on the previous task. Interpretable reinforcement learning, specifically Q-learning, is employed on graph-based tasks with the objective of minimising the number of steps to reach a goal. The study investigates the performance on a previously learned task after training on a new task, for tasks of varying relative levels of complexity. The experimental results reveal a complex dynamic between task similarity and forgetting, with significant fluctuations in forgetting severity observed across degrees of task similarities and task complexities, and are suggestive of an interdependence of forgetting on the similarity and complexity of tasks. The observations were accompanied by observations of high degrees of variability in forgetting and an uneven distribution of task similarity measures. The relationship between these variables remains unclear and no evidence of statistical significance that task similarity has an effect, independently, on forgetting is found in continual reinforcement learning. Further research is warranted to gain a comprehensive understanding of the potential interplay between task similarity and catastrophic forgetting.

</details>


### [90] [Backward Compatibility in Tree-Based Explanations and Enhanced CART Algorithm](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08674)
*Hirofumi Suzuki*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出BCLTX损失度量，用于抑制决策树模型更新前后解释（树结构）的变化，并设计轻量级算法CART-BCTX改进CART以解决决策树更新问题，在10个真实数据集上实现了预测性能与解释兼容性之间的良好平衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 模型更新是机器学习中的基本过程，但更新后解释（explanation）的变化可能对下游决策产生不利影响。现有研究仅关注基于特征贡献（feature contribution）的解释，无法处理基于树结构（tree structure）的解释。决策树因其高透明度常用于风险敏感决策，更新导致的解释变化问题尤为突出。

Method: 1) 提出BCLTX（Backward Compatibility Loss in Tree-based eXplanations），一个损失度量，用于量化并抑制决策树更新前后解释的变化。2) 设计CART-BCTX（CART with Backward Compatibility in Tree-based eXplanations），一种基于CART改进的轻量级算法，在决策树更新过程中最小化BCLTX。

Result: 在包含分类和回归任务的10个真实数据集上，CART-BCTX在预测性能与BCLTX值之间取得了良好的权衡，且计算时间与CART相当，无论任务类型如何。

Conclusion: CART-BCTX能够在不显著牺牲预测性能和计算效率的前提下，有效抑制决策树模型更新导致的解释变化，为风险敏感场景下可解释模型的稳定更新提供了可行方案。

Abstract: In the operation of machine learning models, model update is a fundamental process that requires careful consideration of its impact on downstream decision-making. Particularly when operating explainable models, changes in explanations resulting from model updates can lead to detrimental outcomes for users. Decision trees, due to their high transparency, are frequently employed in risk-sensitive decision-making and serve as a prominent example in which the aforementioned issue is evident. However, existing research addressing similar issues has focused on explanations based on feature contributions, and thus cannot handle explanations derived from tree structures. Therefore, this paper proposes the Backward Compatibility Loss in Tree-based eXplanations (BCLTX), a loss metric that suppresses changes in decision tree explanations before and after updates. Furthermore, we design CART with Backward Compatibility in Tree-based eXplanations (CART-BCTX), a lightweight algorithm that improves upon CART for the decision tree update problem under BCLTX. Experimental results using 10 real-world datasets, including both classification and regression tasks, show that CART-BCTX achieves favorable trade-offs between prediction performances and BCLTX values, with comparable computation times to CART, regardless of the task.

</details>


### [91] [Efficient Test-Time Scaling for LLM-based Time Series Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08675)
*Xuan-May Le,Minh-Tuan Tran,Ling Luo,Uwe Aickelin,Dinh Phung,Trung Le*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出了SCALER，一种由粗到细的时间序列预测框架，先用轻量级Transformer预测未来趋势的粗粒度表示，再引导LLM进行迭代粗到细的残差token精炼，在减少推理计算开销的同时提升长短期和零样本预测性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的基于LLM的时间序列预测方法通过测试时扩展（如迭代精炼）提高精度，但计算成本高，且随着预测视野延长容易产生全局形状失配问题。

Method: SCALER采用两级架构：1）轻量级Transformer专门用于长期形状建模，预测未来的粗粒度动力学表示；2）该预测形状作为紧凑指导条件，引导LLM通过迭代粗到细的残差token精炼进行测试时扩展，每一步只处理显著更少的token。固定步长精炼避免了基于奖励模型的选择，降低计算开销。

Result: 实验表明SCALER在长期、短期和零样本预测中均优于强基线方法，同时显著降低了与LLM扩展相关的时间序列预测推理成本。

Conclusion: 通过显式的未来形状预测引导精炼过程，SCALER减少了对冗长描述提示的依赖，实现了高效且准确的LLM驱动时间序列预测。

Abstract: Long-term time series forecasting benefits from preserving global structure such as trends and seasonality. Recent LLM-based forecasters often improve accuracy through test-time scaling (e.g., iterative refinement), but these methods are computationally expensive and increasingly prone to global-shape mismatch as the prediction horizon extends. We propose SCALER, a coarse-to-fine forecasting framework that first employs a lightweight Transformer tailored to long-term shape modeling to predict a coarse representation of future dynamics. This predicted shape then serves as a compact guide for an LLM to perform test-time scaling via iterative coarse-to-fine residual token refinement, while processing substantially fewer tokens at each step. By guiding refinement with an explicit future-shape prediction, SCALER reduces reliance on long description prompts, and its fixed-step refinement avoids costly reward-model-based selection, further lowering computational overhead. Experimental results demonstrate that SCALER outperforms strong forecasting baselines in long-term, short-term and zero-shot forecasting while significantly reducing the inference cost associated with scaled LLM for time series forecasting. Code: https://github.com/xuanmay2701/SCALER.

</details>


### [92] [RippleKV: Cross-Layer KV Cache Allocation via Perturbation Propagation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08684)
*Dongjie Xu,Kai Qian,Julius,Weijie Shi,Yuxuan Sun,Minghua Tang,Fenglei Jin,Hanchi Dong,Jiajie Xu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: RippleKV是一种基于逐层敏感度分析的长上下文LLM KV缓存分配方法，通过注入范数自适应扰动并测量输出KL散度来估计各层价值缓存对最终预测分布的影响，从而将有限缓存预算分配给真正敏感的网络层。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长上下文LLM推理受限于KV缓存内存，而现有的缓存分配方法（基于层深度、注意力统计或表征变化等代理指标）无法真正衡量各层扰动向输出传播的影响，导致敏感层分配不足而容忍层过度分配。

Method: RippleKV首先在小校准集上向每一层的价值缓存独立注入范数自适应扰动，测量模型输出端诱导的KL散度，通过平均这些响应获得与深度非单调相关的模型特定敏感度剖面；然后将敏感度分数归一化并通过指数映射转换为逐层预算乘数，使用比率参数控制敏感层与容忍层之间的分配差异，最后通过归一化保持总KV缓存预算不变。

Result: 在LongBench基准上的实验表明，在匹配缓存预算的条件下，RippleKV在评估的KV缓存压缩方法中取得了最高的平均性能。

Conclusion: 通过直接测量扰动到输出的传播效应而非依赖层深度等代理指标，RippleKV能够更准确地识别需要更多缓存预算的敏感层，实现更优的逐层缓存分配。

Abstract: Long-context LLM inference is bottlenecked by KV cache memory, yet distributing a limited cache budget across layers remains challenging. Existing methods rely on proxies such as layer depth, attention statistics, or representation change. These proxies do not measure how perturbations at each layer propagate to the output and may therefore cause sensitive layers to be underallocated while tolerant layers are overallocated.
