### [175] [LGNNIC: Acceleration of Large-Scale GNN Training using SmartNICs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07733)
*Liad Gerstman,Aditya Dhakal,Dejan Milojicic,Avi Mendelson*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文提出LGNNIC，一种利用SmartNIC（智能网卡）卸载GNN分布式训练中预处理任务（邻居采样和量化）的新型系统架构，以缓解远程内存节点与计算节点之间的网络拥塞，在标准GNN负载上实现了最高62.4倍和17.5倍的训练加速（分别基于Sockets和DOCA-DMA）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着图规模增大，单节点CPU-GPU系统无法承载完整图数据，分布式存储于多个远程内存节点成为趋势，但训练过程中节点间网络拥塞成为主要瓶颈。现有方案未充分利用现代系统已部署的SmartNIC（与远程内存节点共存），缺乏在SmartNIC层面卸载预处理任务以减少通信量的系统性设计。

Method: LGNNIC利用与远程内存节点共置的SmartNIC（NVIDIA BlueField-2）在预处理阶段执行两项互补技术：(1) Neighbor Sampling——在SmartNIC上完成小批量采样；(2) Quantization——对采样批次进行量化以进一步压缩传输数据量。同时设计了两种同步机制：低开销的DMA-based（DOCA-DMA）和高开销的socket-based基准方案，用于评估不同通信基础设施下的性能。

Result: 在由远程内存节点（含BlueField-2 SmartNIC）和A100 GPU计算节点组成的PoC系统上，邻居采样在Sockets和DOCA-DMA下分别实现最高62.4倍和17.5倍加速，主要得益于数据事务时间的减少；量化在两种方案下分别提供额外最高3.6倍和1.3倍加速，通过减少数据传输量实现。

Conclusion: LGNNIC证明了将邻居采样和量化等预处理任务卸载到SmartNIC是缓解分布式GNN训练中网络拥塞的有效手段，在多数配置下均能带来显著训练加速，为未来大规模图神经网络系统设计提供了可行的架构方向。

Abstract: Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) are widely used across domains such as natural sciences, social network analysis, chip design, and recommendation systems. However, as graph sizes grow, storing and processing them entirely on a single-node CPU-GPU system becomes increasingly impractical. A promising approach is to distribute the graph across multiple remote memory nodes, though this introduces a major bottleneck: inter-node network congestion during training. To address this, we propose LGNNIC, a novel inter-node system architecture that leverages SmartNICs co-located with remote memory nodes-a configuration already available in modern systems-to reduce communication overhead in distributed GNN training. LGNNIC offloads key preprocessing tasks to SmartNICs, reducing the volume of data transferred to computational (training) nodes and alleviating network congestion. We introduce two complementary techniques executed on the SmartNICs during the preprocessing phase: Neighbor Sampling, which performs mini-batch sampling, and Quantization of the sampled batches. To evaluate LGNNIC under different communication infrastructures, we designed both an optimized low-overhead DMA-based synchronization mechanism and a high-overhead socket-based alternative used as a benchmark. We evaluate the core SmartNIC offloading mechanisms across standard GNN workloads and sampling hyperparameters using a proof-of-concept (PoC) system comprising one remote-memory node with an NVIDIA BlueField-2 SmartNIC and one compute node with an A100 GPU. Both Neighbor Sampling and Quantization on the remote node demonstrated substantial training speedups in most configurations. Neighbor Sampling achieved up to 62.4x and 17.5x speedups with Sockets and DOCA-DMA, respectively, primarily due to reduced data transaction time. Quantization provided additional speedups of up to 3.6x and 1.3x, respectively, by reducing data transfer.

</details>


### [176] [ElastiCo: Elastic Configuration and Interference-Aware Orchestration for GPU Clusters](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07971)
*Jinghao Wang,Yihang Zhou,Xiaoyang Sun,Chunming Hu,Tianyu Wo,Xu Wang,Albert Y. Zomaya,Renyu Yang*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: ElastiCo是一个弹性协同放置框架，通过资源形状变换、弹性影子定价和干扰感知协同放置三种机制，让训练和推理工作负载安全共享GPU，无需修改用户代码，在64-GPU测试环境中将平均作业完成时间降低至2.94倍，集群吞吐量提升2.02倍，GPU利用率从约25%提升至46%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代GPU集群需要同时服务深度学习训练和离线大语言模型推理工作负载，但现有调度器将二者视为孤立的资源消费者，采用僵化的静态资源分配，导致GPU资源利用严重不足：训练作业在周期性空闲阶段仍占用整个设备，而离线推理在突发性需求模式下过度配置GPU。

Method: ElastiCo通过三种集成机制实现训练与推理工作负载的安全GPU共享：1) 资源形状变换（Resource Shape Transformation）——将每个作业表示为一系列可行的资源-性能配置；2) 弹性影子定价（Elastic Shadow Pricing）——通过动态每资源影子价格将多资源分配问题分解为按作业的配置选择子问题；3) 干扰感知协同放置（Interference-Aware Co-location）——使用基于硬件计数器和任务级特征训练的预测器来估计GPU共享下的成对性能退化程度。作为原生Kubernetes中间件实现，无需修改用户代码。

Result: 在64-GPU测试环境和多达512 GPU的大规模轨迹驱动模拟评估中，ElastiCo将平均作业完成时间（JCT）降低了至多2.94倍，集群吞吐量提升了2.02倍，GPU利用率从约25%提升至46%。

Conclusion: ElastiCo通过弹性协同放置框架证明了训练与推理工作负载可以在GPU上安全共存，显著提升集群资源利用率、降低作业完成时间并提高吞吐量，且无需对用户代码做任何修改，为异构工作负载的GPU集群调度提供了有效的解决方案。

Abstract: Modern GPU clusters must simultaneously serve deep learning training and offline large language model inference workloads, yet existing schedulers treat these as isolated resource consumers with rigid, static allocations. This leaves substantial GPU capacity underutilized: training jobs reserve entire devices despite periodic idle phases, while offline inference tasks over-provision GPUs despite bursty demand patterns. We present ElastiCo, an elastic co-location framework that enables training and inference workloads to safely share GPUs through three integrated mechanisms. First, Resource Shape Transformation exposes each job as a family of feasible resource-performance configurations. Second, Elastic Shadow Pricing decomposes the resulting multi-resource allocation problem into per-job configuration selection subproblems via dynamic per-resource shadow prices. Third, Interference-Aware Co-location uses a predictor trained on hardware-counter and task-level features to estimate pairwise performance degradation under GPU sharing. Implemented as native Kubernetes middleware requiring no user-code modifications, ElastiCo is evaluated on a 64-GPU testbed and through large-scale trace-driven simulations (up to 512 GPUs), reducing the average JCT by up to 2.94x, increasing the cluster throughput by 2.02x, and increasing the GPU utilization from approximately 25% to 46%.

</details>


### [177] [eIRWR: Enhanced Iterative Random Walk with Restart for Scalable Root Cause Analysis in Microservices](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08073)
*Saiful Khan,Afrah Farea*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文提出eIRWR（增强迭代随机游走重启）方法，用于微服务架构中的根因分析。通过三种增强手段（幂律遥传锐化、自环与反向边、外层循环信念精炼）改进基于图随机游走的异常定位，在阿里巴巴微服务trace数据集上（12K-25K节点）达到MRR=0.75（中等可见性）和0.94（高可见性），较最佳基线提升2.8倍，且推理时间<25ms可在线部署。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于图随机游走的根因分析方法从原始异常向量重启，该向量被下游受害节点主导而忽略了安静的源头节点，导致大量定位信号未被充分利用。此外，已有工作中"弹性阻尼"与重启概率在数学上等价，但现有基准测试未对重启概率做调优，掩盖了方法与简单基准之间的真实差距。

Method: eIRWR包含三个核心改进：(a) 幂律遥传锐化——将重启质量集中在最可疑节点上；(b) 在转移矩阵中引入自环和后向边，使概率在级联源头处累积；(c) 通过外层循环对信念进行迭代精炼。同时，论文澄清了resilience damping与重启概率的数学等价性，并将重启调优的PPR作为更强基准参与对比。

Result: 在阿里巴巴微服务trace数据集的三张大规模拓扑上（12K-25K节点）：eIRWR在中等根因可见性下MRR达0.75，是最佳聚合指标基线的2.8倍，且显著优于重启调优的PPR；高可见性下MRR达0.94；在17,000节点的图上推理时间低于25ms，满足在线部署要求。

Conclusion: eIRWR通过针对性地利用被忽略的根因定位信号，在效率和准确率上均显著超越现有基于随机游走的RCA方法，证明了在微服务大规模依赖图上进行在线根因定位的可行性。

Abstract: Root cause analysis (RCA) in microservice architectures needs to pinpoint the originating faulty service responsible for the cascading symptoms seen across hundreds or thousands of interdependent services. Graph-based random walk methods propagate anomaly evidence over the service dependency graph. However, existing anomaly-restart walks leave much of the localization signal unused: they restart from the raw anomaly vector, which is dominated by loud downstream victims rather than the quieter source. Through a controlled ablation, we first show that the "resilience damping" often applied to the transition matrix is mathematically equivalent to raising the restart probability; we therefore benchmark against a restart-tuned Personalized PageRank (PPR) rather than its default configuration. We then present Enhanced Iterative Random Walk with Restart (eIRWR), which (a) concentrates restart mass on the most suspicious nodes through power-law teleportation sharpening, (b) augments the transition matrix with self-loops and backward edges so that probability accumulates at cascade sources, and (c) refines its belief across an outer loop. On three large-scale topologies (12K-25K nodes) from the Alibaba Microservice Trace Dataset, eIRWR attains a Mean Reciprocal Rank (MRR) of 0.75 at moderate root-cause visibility, a 2.8 times improvement over the best aggregate-metric baseline and well above a restart-tuned PPR. At high visibility, it reaches MRR= 0.94, while running in under 25ms on graphs with 17,000 nodes, making it suitable for online deployment.

</details>


### [178] [Effect of Abstractions and Prompting Strategies on LLM-Guided High-Performance Optimizations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08085)
*Jiří Klepl,Maty'aš Brabec,Martin Kruliš*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文研究了在LLM引导的并行HPC代码优化中，传统自动化优化抽象（如Polyhedral框架）是否比直接生成C代码更有效。实验表明，在PolyBench基准测试中，LLM直接生成C代码在性能和正确性上优于通过传统框架构建计算流水线和优化调度的方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 代码性能优化需要深厚的底层硬件知识和并行处理知识，即使对经验丰富的开发者也很具挑战性。随着LLM日益强大的代码生成和理解能力，业界对其在自动化代码优化中的应用日益感兴趣。然而，传统自动化优化依赖特定领域的表示形式和有限的可行变换集，而LLM可以理解高层代码语义并进行超出可验证自动化优化的变换。本文的核心动机是探究传统的自动化代码优化抽象是否有助于提升LLM引导优化的效果。

Method: 使用PolyBench基准测试套件，对比两种LLM引导的代码优化路径：（1）LLM直接生成C代码（具有特定优化目标）；（2）LLM通过传统框架（如Polyhedral模型）创建计算流水线和优化调度。评估指标包括测量性能和代码有效性（validity rates）。

Result: 在评估的设置下，LLM在获得特定优化目标时直接生成C代码，其测量性能和有效性比率均优于通过传统框架构建计算流水线和优化调度的方式。

Conclusion: 传统的自动化代码优化抽象并未提升LLM引导优化的效果，反而可能成为制约。未来应探索替代方法来实现可验证的LLM引导代码优化，而非依赖传统框架的限制性表示。

Abstract: Code performance optimization is a vital aspect of modern software development, as it enables faster response times and reduced resource usage. These optimizations require a deep understanding of low-level hardware details and the intricacies of parallel processing, making them challenging even for experienced developers. With the advent of Large Language Models (LLMs), which are increasingly capable of generating and understanding code, there is growing interest in incorporating these models into automated code optimization processes. Traditionally, this automation involves transcribing the source code into a domain-specific representation that can be auto-tuned using grid search or machine learning algorithms, while adhering to strict rules and a limited set of feasible transformations to ensure verifiability. LLMs incorporate high-level code semantics and can thus perform transformations that go beyond verifiable automated optimizations. This paper investigates whether the traditional abstractions used in automated code optimization improve the performance and correctness of LLM-guided optimizations of parallel HPC applications. We evaluate this using the PolyBench benchmark suite and demonstrate that, in our evaluated setting, LLMs provided with specific optimization goals achieve better measured performance and validity rates when generating C code compared to creating computation pipelines and optimization schedules with established frameworks, suggesting that future development should explore alternative approaches for verifiable LLM-guided code optimization.

</details>


### [179] [OasisKV: Scaling In-Decode KV Cache Beyond HBM with Lookahead Sparse Prefetching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08097)
*Can Xiao,Sukmin Cho,Junbong We,Zhixiong Niu,Jianyi Cheng,Yiren Zhao,Youngjin Kwon,Yongqiang Xiong,Rui Ma,Junyi Liu*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: OasisKV 是一个面向 LLM 推理的内存中心型系统设计，通过解耦 KV 缓存存储与 HBM 来缓解显存容量压力。利用解码期注意力稀疏性和投机解码（SD）的 lookahead token 提前预测重要 KV 块，将其从高容量内存层级预取到 HBM 中用于注意力计算，在不显著损失精度的前提下大幅提升吞吐量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM 推理服务正从计算密集型转向内存受限型。随着长上下文和长链推理任务普及，KV 缓存成为 token 生成（decode）阶段内存占用和内存流量（memory traffic）的主导因素。HBM 容量成为稀缺且昂贵的资源，严重限制了推理批次大小和系统吞吐量。

Method: OasisKV 将完整 KV 缓存存储从 HBM 中解耦出来（放置在主机内存或远程内存等更高容量层级），仅在 HBM 中保留最相关 token 的 KV 条目。具体方法包括：(1) 利用解码期注意力的自然稀疏性；(2) 借助投机解码（SD）生成的 lookahead tokens 对未来重要 token 进行提前准确预测；(3) 采用高效的注意力后台管线（background pipeline）识别重要 KV 块并预取到 HBM，在下一步解码前完成暂存。

Result: 基于 vLLM 实现。在 2,048 token 的 KV 预算下，lookahead 预测的精度与完整注意力相差不超过 0.7 个点。在推理类工作负载上相比完整 vLLM 获得 1.69 倍吞吐提升（仅 0.1 点精度损失）；多 GPU 长上下文服务下最高达 2.1 倍。在 prefill-decode 分离架构下，吞吐量约为稠密模式的 2 倍，每个请求的 KV 传递量减少 6.5-9.7 倍，decode 节点主机内存占用减少 2.2-2.6 倍。

Conclusion: OasisKV 证明了解码期注意力的稀疏性结合投机解码的精确前瞻预测，可以在几乎不损失精度的前提下将 KV 缓存放回低成本大容量内存层级，将稀疏性转化为系统级吞吐增益，有效解决 LLM 推理中 HBM 容量瓶颈问题。

Abstract: Large language model (LLM) inference serving is increasingly constrained by memory rather than compute. As long-context and long-form reasoning workloads become more prevalent, the key-value (KV) cache dominates both memory footprint and memory traffic during LLM token generation, i.e., decode. In particular, HBM capacity has become a scarce and costly resource that heavily limits inference batch size and system throughput. This paper presents OasisKV, a memory-centric LLM inference system design that alleviates HBM capacity pressure by decoupling full KV-cache storage from HBM during LLM decoding. Because decode-time attention is naturally sparse, OasisKV keeps only the KV entries of the most relevant tokens in HBMs for attention computation. We observe that future important tokens can be predicted accurately in advance using lookahead tokens drafted by speculative decoding (SD). OasisKV employs an efficient attention background pipeline to identify important KV blocks. They are then prefetched from higher-capacity memory tiers (e.g., host or remote memory) and staged in HBMs before being used in the next decode step.
  We implement OasisKV based on vLLM. The lookahead prediction is accurate enough to keep accuracy within 0.7 points of full attention under a 2,048-token KV budget. This lets OasisKV turn sparsity into throughput gain: $1.69\times$ over dense vLLM on the reasoning workload at 0.1 points of accuracy loss, and up to $2.1\times$ on multi-GPU long-context serving. Under prefill--decode disaggregation, OasisKV reaches about $2\times$ dense throughput while admitting each request with $6.5$--$9.7\times$ less KV and holding $2.2$-$2.6$ less decode-node host memory than full KV transfer.

</details>


### [180] [Evaluating and Improving Weak Scalability Analysis of Visualization Algorithms](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08166)
*Marvin Petersen,Jonas Lukasczyk,Christoph Garth*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文指出大规模数据可视化研究的弱可扩展性评估中，传统的数据缩放方法仅增加输入数据量，而忽略了算法工作负载还受数据复杂度和输出大小等因素影响，导致弱可扩展性评估不准确。作者通过多种算法和数据集对比不同缩放方法，提出一种在共享内存环境下有效缓解工作负载增加不一致性的方法，以推动更严谨的可扩展性评估与报告。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 弱可扩展性是评估可视化算法在大规模下适用性的重要指标，但传统上通过简单放大输入数据规模来生成更大数据集的做法存在缺陷：许多可视化算法的工作负载不仅取决于输入大小，还受数据复杂度或输出大小影响，导致弱可扩展性评估结果不准确。

Method: 作者在多种算法和数据集上系统性地比较了不同的数据缩放方法，识别了各算法与数据集之间缩放方法适用性的差异，并提出了一种在共享内存环境下能有效缓解不同缩放方法导致的工作负载增加不一致性的方法。

Result: 研究表明不同缩放方法在不同算法和数据集上的适用性存在显著差异；所提出的方法能够有效缓解各缩放方法间工作负载增加的不一致性问题。

Conclusion: 本文呼吁可视化领域在评估和报告可扩展性研究时，需要更深入地考虑缩放方法对工作负载的影响，推动更严谨的可扩展性评价标准。

Abstract: Research on visualizing large-scale datasets traditionally relies on empirical evaluation of scalability, determining the effectiveness of specific computation methods, algorithmic strategies, or implementations. Weak scalability, which assesses the algorithm's performance as problem size and computing resources increase, is a valuable indicator for a method's applicability at scale. However, sufficiently large data sets with increasing size are needed for weak scalability studies. To this end, it is customary to use simple scaling techniques to increase problem size by generating larger input data sets from a base data set. Nevertheless, many visualization algorithms' workload depends on factors beyond input size, such as input data complexity or output size, leading to inaccuracies in the attributed weak scalability. In this work, we highlight different common data scaling methods on multiple algorithms and data sets, recognizing that the suitability of scaling approaches varies across algorithms and data sets. We present a method that effectively mitigates the observed inconsistencies in workload increases for the different scaling methods in a shared-memory setting. With this work, we aim to further the discussion on how to evaluate and report scalable visualization research.

</details>


### [181] [OpRAG: A Resource-Deterministic Runtime for GPU-Backed Multi-Stage RAG Workflows](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08340)
*Arup Kumar Sarker,Mills Staylor,Aymen Alsaadi,Gregor von Laszewski,Shantenu Jha,Geoffrey Fox*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: OpRAG是一个面向GPU后端多阶段RAG工作流的资源确定性分布式运行时，将嵌入、检索、推理、记忆和更新建模为一等算子并编译为通信感知执行图，通过零拷贝数据面、持久化worker、有界队列、CPU tokenizer预取、批量化GPU嵌入和检索/生成重叠执行等技术，在不修改LLM解码内核的前提下显著降低非模型开销，相比最接近的竞争对手提升约16%端到端性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 虽然LLM解码受GPU约束，但RAG系统的编排层（预处理、嵌入、检索、上下文构建等）通过序列化开销、碎片化调度、低效批处理和CPU-GPU流水线停顿仍然限制端到端性能。现有框架要么提供灵活的控制流（如LangChain），要么提供可扩展的任务并行（如Ray），但都没有将RAG阶段暴露为具有资源感知和确定性执行语义的算子。

Method: OpRAG将嵌入、检索、推理、记忆和更新作为一等算子建模，并将其降级为通信感知执行图。核心设计包括：Arrow零拷贝数据平面、持久化worker、有界队列、CPU tokenizer预取、批量化GPU嵌入以及检索/生成重叠执行，以最小化LLM推理周围的非模型开销。

Result: 使用Llama3-8B和Mistral-7B（FlashAttention 2、BF16、32K RAG块）评估：相比最近竞争者分别提升16.16%和15.66%，相比RayScalableRAG提升20.57%和20.71%，相比LangChain、LangGraph、CrewAI和AutoGen中最佳基线分别快17.77%和17.48%。在Higress风格查询服务中，混合检索延迟降低59.20-59.62%，生成场景延迟降低52.48-53.55%，同时保持100% Recall@5。

Conclusion: 优化分布式编排层可以在不修改LLM解码内核的情况下大幅提升GPU后端多阶段RAG的性能，证明了编排层优化的重要性。

Abstract: Agentic retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems combine preprocessing, embedding, retrieval, memory access, context construction, generation, and vector-index updates. Although LLM decoding is GPU-bound, the surrounding orchestration layer can still limit end-to-end performance through serialization overhead, fragmented scheduling, inefficient batching, and CPU--GPU pipeline stalls. Existing frameworks provide flexible control flow, while distributed runtimes provide scalable task parallelism, but neither exposes RAG stages as resource-aware operators with deterministic execution semantics. We present OpRAG, a resource-deterministic distributed runtime for GPU-backed multi-stage RAG workflows. OpRAG models embedding, retrieval, reasoning, memory, and upsert as first-class operators and lowers them into communication-aware execution graphs. It combines an Arrow zero-copy data plane, persistent workers, bounded queues, CPU tokenizer prefetching, batched GPU embedding, and overlapped retrieval/generation execution to reduce non-model overhead around LLM inference. We evaluate OpRAG using Llama3-8B and Mistral-7B with FlashAttention~2, BF16 execution, and 32K RAG chunks. In end-to-end GPU pipeline experiments, OpRAG improves over the nearest competitor by 16.16% for Llama3-8B and 15.66% for Mistral-7B, and over RayScalableRAG by 20.57% and 20.71%, respectively. Against LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, and AutoGen, OpRAG is 17.77% and 17.48% faster than the best framework baseline. In Higress-style query serving, OpRAG reduces hybrid retrieval latency by 59.20--59.62% and generation-scenario latency by 52.48--53.55%, while preserving 100% Recall@5. These results show that optimizing the distributed orchestration layer can substantially improve GPU-backed multi-stage RAG without modifying the LLM decoding kernel.

</details>


### [182] [Empirical Analysis of Cloud-Edge Infrastructure Complexity: Practitioner Pain Points and Architectural Directions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08400)
*Pawissanutt Lertpongrujikorn,Hai Duc Nguyen,Mohsen Amini Salehi*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 基于对86个组织的101次半结构化访谈的实证分析，验证了部署复杂性和入职困难是云原生开发的主要瓶颈，并提出了四个解决这些痛点的架构方向（统一对象抽象、内部开发者平台、声明式AI/ML服务管道、基于WebAssembly的轻量级边缘运行时），结论表明分布式计算采用的主要障碍是基础设施复杂性而非执行性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 云、边缘和物联网计算的普及带来了分布式应用开发的机会，但同时也引入了巨大的基础设施复杂性，成为开发者生产力和创新的显著障碍。现有研究缺乏对云原生开发现状的量化实证分析，需要系统性地识别真实的痛点、优先级和期望，以指导架构演进方向。

Method: 采用基于86个组织、101次半结构化访谈的实证研究方法，对云原生开发实践、痛点与期望进行定量分析；基于验证的痛点，提出并考察四个架构方向及其所需的多利益相关者生态系统。

Result: 定量验证了部署复杂性（38.6%）和入职困难（35.6%）是主要运营瓶颈；开发者优先关注生产力（53.5%）和自动化（44.6%）而非原始性能优化；四个架构方向（Object-as-a-Service、内部开发者平台、声明式AI/ML管道、Wasm边缘运行时）可有效缓解识别的痛点；安全、运维集成和严格多租户隔离是生产就绪的前提条件。

Conclusion: 分布式计算采用的主要障碍在于基础设施复杂性而非执行性能，跨多种范式的声明式、更高级别的抽象为解决这一问题提供了可行的架构路径。

Abstract: The proliferation of cloud, edge, and Internet of Things (IoT) computing has created unprecedented opportunities for distributed applications. However, this architectural shift introduces profound infrastructural complexity, acting as a significant barrier to developer productivity and innovation. In this paper, we present an empirical analysis based on 101 semi-structured interviews across 86 organizations to investigate the state of cloud-native development practices, pain points, and expectations. Our findings quantitatively validate that deployment complexity (38.6%) and onboarding difficulty (35.6%) are the dominant operational bottlenecks, while developers heavily prioritize productivity (53.5%) and automation (44.6%) over raw performance optimization. Based on these empirical insights, we examine four architectural directions that address the validated pain points: unified object abstractions (Object-as-a-Service), platform engineering via Internal Developer Platforms, declarative AI/ML serving pipelines, and lightweight edge runtimes based on WebAssembly. Furthermore, we detail the multi-stakeholder ecosystem required for adopting novel infrastructure paradigms, emphasizing that security, operational integration, and strict multi-tenant isolation are prerequisites for production readiness. Our results demonstrate that the primary barrier to distributed computing adoption is not execution performance but infrastructural complexity, and that declaratively governed, higher-level abstractions across multiple paradigms offer viable architectural paths toward alleviating it.

</details>


### [183] [FlashBoot: Sub-Second Weight Loading for Large Models at Rack Scale](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08482)
*Issac Zhu,Hscos Zhang,Keith Jiang,Jack Li,Hugh Yin,Jason Zhao*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: FlashBoot 是一个基于 SGLang 构建的硬件友好、框架工作流协同设计的权重加载子系统，通过 FabricArena（连续、可导出、节点间可寻址的张量内存布局）、FlashLoad（CPU 批量零拷贝加载）和 FlashClone（远程 GPU 映射复制，消除 NCCL 设置开销）三大核心机制，在 GB300 NVL72 上将单节点权重加载提速最多 50x、并发机架级部署提速 270x。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 旗舰 MoE 模型在总参数量和专家数两个维度同时快速增长，弹性部署场景下多节点 GPU 需要快速就绪，权重加载成为延迟预算中不可忽视的部分。即便在 NVIDIA GB300 NVL72 这样的顶级硬件上，现有加载器也未能用满带宽，原因是结构性的：(C1) 权重内存碎片化为数万个 per-tensor 对象导致传输远低于链路带宽；(C2) 跨节点复制受 NCCL 通信子建立开销阻塞（10-110 秒）；(C3) 现有跨节点 GPU 直连克隆路径是串行的，多节点并发启动时扩展性差。

Method: FlashBoot 三层设计：(1) FabricArena——一种连续、可导出且节点间可寻址的张量内存布局，从根源上消除权重内存碎片化；(2) FlashLoad——将权重从 CPU 以单一批量、零拷贝传输方式加载；(3) FlashClone——通过远程映射机制将已驻留模型从远端 GPU 复制，完全绕开 NCCL 通信子设置。整体基于 SGLang 框架进行框架与工作流的协同设计。

Result: 在 NVL72 上对 DeepSeek-V4-Pro 和 DeepSeek-V4-Flash 的实验中：FlashClone 映射远程权重内存仅需约 10ms（对比 NCCL 的 10-110s），每个克隆可维持 >=700 GB/s 吞吐；FlashBoot 将单节点权重加载从 20.1s 加速到 0.4s（50x），并发机架级权重加载从 87s 加速到 0.32s（270x+）。

Conclusion: FlashBoot 通过 Tensor 内存布局重构（FabricArena）、批量零拷贝 CPU 加载（FlashLoad）和远程内存映射替代 NCCL 通信（FlashClone）三个协同设计的创新，系统性解决了 MoE 弹性部署中权重加载的结构性瓶颈，展现出数量级的性能提升，代码将开源。

Abstract: Flagship Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models are growing fast along two axes at once: total parameter count and the number of experts. In elastic deployment scenarios, many GPUs across many nodes must become serving-ready quickly, and this growth makes weight loading a noticeable part of the latency budget. Even on NVIDIA's GB300 NVL72, today's state-of-the-art loaders leave most of that bandwidth unused. The losses are structural: (C1) weight memory is fragmented into tens of thousands of per-tensor objects, so transfers run far below link bandwidth; (C2) cross-node replication is gated by NCCL communicator setup, which costs 10-110 s before a single weight byte moves; and (C3) the existing cross-node GPU->GPU clone path is serial and scales poorly to concurrent multi-node bring-up. We present FlashBoot, a hardware-friendly, framework-workflow co-designed weight-loading subsystem built on SGLang. At its core is FabricArena, a contiguous, exportable and inter-node addressable tensor memory layout. On top of it, FlashLoad loads from CPU as a single bulk, zero-copy transfer, and FlashClone replicates a resident model from a remote GPU via a remote-mapping mechanism that removes NCCL setup. In experiments on NVL72 with DeepSeek-V4-Pro and DeepSeek-V4-Flash, FlashClone maps remote weight memory in ~10 ms (versus 10-110 s for NCCL) and sustains >=700 GB/s per clone. Against the state of the art, FlashBoot accelerates single-node weight loading by up to 50x (from 20.1 s to 0.4 s) and concurrent rack-level weight loading by >270x (from 87 s to 0.32 s). Our code will be made publicly available.

</details>


### [184] [C2C-Explorer: An Exploration Framework for Chip-to-Chip Interconnect Architectures in LLM Cloud Computing Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08611)
*Jiayi Li,Di Wu,Qingxu Li,Hongxiao Zhao,Jiaqi Yang,Anjunyi Fan,Wenbin Zhang,Boqiang Wu,Shuting Liu,Shifeng Fang,Jianbo Dong,Dimin Niu,Bonan Yan*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 提出C2C-Explorer，一个基于自适应贝叶斯设计的DSE框架，用于大语言模型工作负载下的芯片间（C2C）通信硬件架构协同设计。它集成了LLM工作负载驱动的流量生成器、可扩展的互连模拟器（支持最高512芯片）和指标引导评估器，在32-XPU DeepSeek-R1-671B推理工作负载上实现了44.1%的吞吐量提升和98.4%的内存降低。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型（LLM）的扩展需要多处理器芯片架构的计算系统，这使得芯片间（C2C）通信变得至关重要。然而，设计高效的C2C硬件架构面临三大挑战：产生真实的LLM特定C2C流量、在规模上准确模拟硬件级通信、以及高效探索指数级增长的C2C设计空间。

Method: 提出C2C-Explorer，一个自适应贝叶斯DSE框架，包含三个核心组件：(1) LLM工作负载驱动的流量生成器；(2) 可扩展互连模拟器（支持switch/full-mesh拓扑，最多512芯片）；(3) 指标引导的评估器。该框架将三者整合为从工作负载到硬件的优化流水线，采用混合周期/事件模型加速大规模模拟。

Result: 基于FPGA C2C原型验证，模拟器在不同流量模式下实现了2.46-8.23%的端到端时序误差；混合周期与事件模型相比纯周期精确基线将大规模仿真加速最高7.8倍。应用于32-XPU DeepSeek-R1-671B推理工作负载时，C2C-Explorer识别出的配置使goodput提升44.1%并降低98.4%内存占用。

Conclusion: C2C-Explorer为LLM场景下的C2C硬件架构设计提供了一个系统化的工作负载到硬件协同优化方案，兼顾模拟精度与速度，能够有效探索庞大设计空间并取得显著性能收益。项目已开源。

Abstract: The scaling-up of large language models (LLMs) necessitates computing systems to have multi-processor-chip architectures, elevating the importance of chip-to-chip (C2C) communication. However, designing efficient C2C hardware architectures for LLM workloads faces three key challenges: generating realistic LLM-specific C2C traffic, accurately simulating hardware-level communication at scale, and efficiently exploring the exponentially large C2C design space. We propose C2C-Explorer, an adaptive Bayesian DSE framework that integrates a LLM-workload-driven traffic generator, a scalable interconnect simulator (switch/full-mesh, up to 512 chips), and a metric-guided evaluator into a workload-to-hardware optimization pipeline, enabling systematic C2C architectural co-design under realistic LLM workloads. Validated against FPGA-based C2C prototypes, the C2C simulator achieves 2.46-8.23% end-to-end timing error across diverse traffic patterns. Its hybrid cycle and event model further accelerates large-scale simulation by up to 7.8$\times$ over a pure cycle-accurate baseline. Applied to a 32-XPU DeepSeek-R1-671B inference workload, C2C-Explorer identifies configurations that improve goodput by 44.1% and reduce memory by 98.4%. C2C-Explorer is open-source and available at https://github.com/Selinaee/C2C-Explorer.

</details>


### [185] [Randomized Tree-Intersection Leader Election](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08817)
*Yuval Emek,Shay Kutten,Ido Rafael,Gadi Taubenfeld*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种在CONGEST模型下同步完全n节点图上进行随机领导者选举的算法，通过单一分支参数ℓ在时间复杂度与每节点消息复杂度之间实现高度可调的权衡，同时保持严格次线性（O(√n log^1.5 n)）的总消息复杂度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在分布式系统中，领导者选举的时间复杂度和消息复杂度往往需要权衡，而现有算法缺乏灵活的调节机制。作者希望提供一种可通过单一参数平滑调节资源分配的系统化框架，使网络设计者能根据带宽约束或时间约束自由选择操作点。

Method: 利用动态截断的ℓ元树扩展，结合一种新颖的"静默脉冲"验证机制。通过强制扩展形成精确容量的近完全树，节点可以在不超出次线性消息界限的情况下安全聚合拓扑权重。算法实现了O(log_ℓ √(n log n))的时间复杂度和O(ℓ)的每节点消息复杂度。

Result: 算法实现了O(log_ℓ √(n log n))轮时间复杂度和O(ℓ)每节点消息复杂度，同时保持O(√n log^1.5 n)的严格次线性总消息复杂度。当ℓ=O(1)时获得最小每节点负担，当ℓ较大时（如ℓ=Θ(√n)量级）可将选举压缩到O(1)轮。

Conclusion: 该算法为领导者选举提供了前所未有的灵活权衡空间：从低带宽场景（O(1)每节点消息、O(log n)时间）到高带宽场景（O(1)时间、更高每节点消息）均可平滑过渡，且总消息复杂度始终保持次线性，适合不同资源约束的分布式网络环境。

Abstract: We present a randomized leader election algorithm for synchronous complete $n$-node graphs in the \textsf{CONGEST} model that introduces a highly tunable trade-off between time complexity and the per-node message complexity. By adjusting a single branching parameter, $\ell$, system designers can smoothly shift the algorithmic burden from execution time to per-node message complexity, all while maintaining a strictly sublinear total message complexity of $O(\sqrt{n} \log^{1.5} n)$. We achieve this by utilizing dynamically truncated $\ell$-ary tree expansions coupled with a novel ``silent pulse'' verification mechanism. By forcing the expansions to form exact-volume almost-complete trees, nodes can safely aggregate topological weights without overshooting the sublinear message bounds. Specifically, our algorithm achieves $O(\log_\ell \sqrt{n \log n})$ time (round) complexity and $O(\ell)$ per-node message complexity. This flexibility allows networks with tight bandwidth constraints to operate with a minimal $O(1)$ per-node burden, while high-bandwidth environments can collapse the election into $O(1)$ time units.

</details>


### [186] [Universal Rendezvous of Anonymous Agents with Footprints](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08981)
*Bibhuti Das*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文回答了一个开放问题：在匿名图模型下，两个匿名移动代理通过"足迹"（在每个未标记节点上留下永久印记）进行确定性汇合，是否对所有可行实例存在通用汇合算法。作者给出了肯定答案，提出了一个适用于所有连通图（有限或可数无限）实例的通用汇合算法，从而解决了Das和Pelc（SPAA 2026）提出的开放问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 该论文旨在回答Das和Pelc在SPAA 2026提出的开放问题：在带足迹的模型中，是否存在一个对全类实例通用的汇合算法。此前这一问题尚未解决，作者的目标是给出肯定或否定的答案，从而完善该模型下的汇合理论。

Method: 作者考虑了带足迹（footprints）的汇合模型，即代理每次访问未标记节点时留下永久且相同的足迹。基于此假设，作者构造了一个通用汇合算法，该算法适用于底层图为连通图（有限或可数无限）的所有实例。算法设计的关键在于利用足迹提供的记忆信息，使两个从不同节点同步出发的匿名代理能够在确定性条件下保证汇合。

Result: 提出了一个通用汇合算法，对底层图中所有连通（有限或可数无限）的实例均保证汇合。这证明了带足迹模型中所有实例的类别存在通用算法，从而对开放问题给出了肯定回答。

Conclusion: 该工作解决了Das和Pelc提出的开放问题，证明了在带足迹的匿名图模型中，对所有可行实例（底层图连通，有限或可数无限）存在通用确定性汇合算法，为匿名移动代理汇合问题的理论框架做出了重要补充。

Abstract: Deterministic rendezvous for two anonymous mobile agents starting simultaneously from two distinct nodes of an anonymous connected graph and navigating synchronously in the graph requires that they meet at some node. An instance of the rendezvous problem is the underlying graph, together with two distinct nodes that are the initial positions of the agents. Such an instance is said to be feasible if there is a deterministic algorithm guaranteeing rendezvous, possibly valid only for this instance. A rendezvous algorithm is said to be universal for a class of instances if it guarantees rendezvous for all feasible instances from this class.
  We consider the model with footprints: whenever an agent visits an unmarked node, it leaves a permanent footprint on it, and all footprints are identical. This paper aims at answering the open problem from the paper by Das and Pelc (SPAA 2026), asking whether there exists a universal rendezvous algorithm for the class of all instances in the model with footprints. We propose a universal rendezvous algorithm for the class of all instances where the underlying graph is connected (finite or countably infinite) in the model with footprints. This shows the existence of a universal algorithm for the class of all instances in the model with footprints, which is an affirmative answer to the open problem.

</details>


### [187] [A Resource-centric Analysis and Optimization of NoSQL Workloads using Distressed Resource Volume Metric](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09173)
*Gunika Verma,Aashutosh A,Pooja Srinivas,Yogesh Simmhan,Ayush Choure,Harshit Shah,Mayukh Das,Prashant Sasatte,Chetan Bansal,Abhijit Pai,Suraj Dixit,Achint Agrawal*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文提出面向NoSQL云数据库负载打包与迁移(PAM)优化的端到端基准流水线，包括从Cosmos DB真实集群收集的开源工作负载、用于衡量终端用户体验质量的分布式资源卷(DRV)指标、基于非参数统计模型的LoadStar模拟框架、用于预测负载分布的Luna模型，以及利用预测触发重均衡的Orbit PAM算法。实验表明Orbit相比现有策略和worst-fit基线，在更低的错误率下交付更高负载，资源节省高达35%，已部署生产环境，预估每年节省数亿美元。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大规模托管云数据库依赖精细的负载打包与迁移(PAM)算法来保证规模运营效率，但缺乏公开的NoSQL工作负载数据严重限制了资源优化与可靠性方面的研究进展。

Method: 1) 从Cosmos DB真实集群提取并开源NoSQL工作负载；2) 定义新的可靠性指标DRV（分布式资源卷）捕捉端用户体验的服务质量；3) 构建LoadStar开源策略模拟框架，使用非参数统计模型估计真实流量模式的QoS；4) 设计Luna模型预测未来负载分布；5) 提出Orbit PAM算法，利用预测结果触发和重均衡压力副本以减少尾部错误。

Result: 基于LoadStar对真实工作负载的验证显示，Orbit相比现有Cosmos DB策略和最差适配优化基线具有明显优势：在更低错误率下交付更高负载，资源消耗减少高达35%。该系统已部署至生产环境，预计每年节省数亿美元成本，同时改善数百万客户的服务可靠性。

Conclusion: 通过公开真实工作负载、定义DRV指标并结合预测驱动的Orbit PAM算法，本文为NoSQL云数据库的负载管理与可靠性优化提供了可复用的基准流水线，在生产环境中验证了其显著的经济效益和可靠性的提升。

Abstract: Large-scale managed cloud databases leverage sophisticated load Packing and Migration (PAM) algorithms, which provide the efficiencies necessary for running these services at scale on cloud resources. Research into optimizing the resources and reliability of cloud databases at massive scales is limited by a lack of public NoSQL workloads. We address this in the context of Cosmos DB, Microsoft's flagship cloud-hosted NoSQL database. We first propose open-source NoSQL workloads from real Cosmos DB clusters, and analyze these traces to derive a novel reliability metric, Distressed Resource Volume (DRV), which captures the quality of service experienced by the end user. We then develop an open-source policy simulation framework, LoadStar, powered by a non-parametric statistical model of estimating the QoS of real traffic patterns. These form a reusable benchmark pipeline for validating policies for resource-centric NoSQL workloads. We then define a resource optimization problem for placing Cosmos DB replicas onto VM nodes, develop the Luna model for forecasting future load distributions, and the Orbit PAM algorithm that uses these forecasts to trigger and rebalance stressed replicas, to reduce tail-errors. Our experiments, validated using LoadStar for these workloads, demonstrate Orbit's benefits over the existing Cosmos DB policy and a worst-fit optimized baseline, with higher load delivered at lower error rates and up to $35\%$ reduction in resources. These have been deployed in production, with potential savings of $\$100M$s/yr while improving service reliability for millions of customers.

</details>


### [188] [Beyond Fast Contractions: Attenuation and Recovery of Matrix-Engine Speedups in High-Order Finite Elements](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09175)
*Yinuo Wang,Lin Gan,Tianqi Mao,Zeyu Song,Wubing Wan,Jiayu Fu,Zekun Yin,Yuyang Jin,Xiaohui Duan,Wei Xue,Guangwen Yang*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文研究SPECFEM3D地震仿真中的刚度算子在现代处理器矩阵引擎（SME）上的性能差距。尽管SME的单精度峰值算力是SVE的4倍，但完整算子的加速比仅从1.1倍提升至1.6倍，主要瓶颈在于逐点计算、间接场搬运、同步和系数访问等非张量收缩部分。研究通过因子化诊断和多种优化手段（显式SIMD、场布局调整、向量分块系数流）验证了系统性协同设计整个算子路径的必要性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代处理器提供的矩阵引擎峰值算力远超传统SIMD，但科学应用很难将这一优势端到端转化为实际性能。作者以Arm LX2 CPU上的SPECFEM3D刚度算子为案例，量化并诊断了这一"峰值算力—实际速度"之间的鸿沟，希望揭示矩阵引擎性能发挥的真实瓶颈所在。

Method: 在匹配的高性能SVE基线上对比SME（可伸缩矩阵扩展）的实际性能；采用因子化诊断方法逐层定位性能损失来源，区分张量收缩、逐点计算、间接字段搬运、同步和系数传递等环节的贡献；随后分别施加显式SIMD优化、场布局调整和向量块系数流优化，并给出收缩无法实现的理论上界。

Result: SME相对于SVE的4倍单精度峰值优势在实际中衰减：孤立张量收缩仅剩2.2倍加速，完整算子仅1.1倍。通过显式SIMD优化逐点计算将完整算子加速提升至1.3倍；结合场布局调整和向量分块系数流后，高阶场景下达到1.6倍；纯收缩优化理论上限仅为1.11~1.32倍。

Conclusion: 发挥矩阵引擎性能不能仅替换收缩（contraction）内核，必须对整个算子路径进行协同设计，将逐点计算、内存访问模式、数据布局和同步机制等全局环节一并纳入优化范畴。

Abstract: Modern processors increasingly provide matrix engines whose peak arithmetic throughput greatly exceeds conventional SIMD, but scientific applications rarely realize this advantage end to end. We examine this gap in SPECFEM3D's dominant stiffness operator on the Arm LX2 CPUs that power the flagship Lineshine supercomputer. Against a matched, high-performance SVE baseline on the same cores, SME's $4\times$ single-precision peak advantage falls to $2.2\times$ for isolated tensor contractions and $1.1\times$ for the complete operator. Our factorized diagnostic attributes the loss to pointwise computation, indirect field movement and synchronization, and irregular coefficient delivery. Explicit SIMD mitigates pointwise work, raising the full-operator speedup to $1.3\times$. Field-layout changes mitigate indirect movement and synchronization, while vector-blocked coefficient streaming reduces irregular-access costs; together they raise speedup to $1.6\times$ at high order. A contraction-free control bounds further contraction-only gains at $1.11$--$1.32\times$. Realizing matrix-engine performance therefore requires co-designing the entire operator path, not merely replacing its contraction kernel.

</details>


### [189] [UnionSparse: An Index-Efficient Sparsity Framework for Low-Bit Sparse LLM Inference on Edge](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09291)
*Tianhao Jiang,Hang Gu,Teng Wang,Qianyu Cheng,ZhenDong Zheng,Cheng Tang,Qiyue Su,Wenqi Lou,Lei Gong,Chao Wang,Xi Li,Xuehai Zhou*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文提出UnionSparse框架，通过引入载荷-元数据比（PMR）作为关键指标，结合索引高效位图编码（IE-BME）和低比特共享内存并行解码（LSPD）SpMM内核，解决边缘GPU上低比特稀疏LLM推理中稀疏元数据开销过大的问题，在W4A4量化下相对FlashLLM、SpInfer、CUTLASS和cuBLAS分别提升2.30x、1.43x、1.56x和3.46x。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 边缘LLM推理结合稀疏性和低比特量化以满足设备内存、延迟和功耗限制。然而，量化压缩了权重载荷却没有成比例减少稀疏元数据，导致索引流量和非零值提取成为SpMM的关键瓶颈。以往工作忽视了元数据开销对有效计算强度的影响，亟需一种索引高效的推理方案。

Method: 提出PMR（载荷-元数据比）指标以量化稀疏元数据与有效载荷的比例关系，并据此设计UnionSparse框架。该框架包含两部分：1) IE-BME（索引高效位图编码），摊销元数据开销并将稀疏遍历与fragment组装对齐；2) LSPD（低比特共享内存并行解码），改进小批量执行效率。

Result: 在W4A4量化和30%-70%稀疏度条件下，UnionSparse相比FlashLLM和SpInfer分别获得2.30x和1.43x加速，相比CUTLASS和cuBLAS Tensor Core分别获得1.56x和3.46x加速。

Conclusion: 实验结果确立了载荷提取效率（PMR）作为边缘GPU低比特稀疏推理中一阶关注因素的地位，表明索引开销优化与量化策略同等重要。

Abstract: Edge LLM inference combines sparsity and low-bit quantization to meet device memory, latency, and power limits. Yet quantization shrinks weight payloads without proportionally reducing sparse metadata, so index traffic and nonzero extraction become critical SpMM bottlenecks. We introduce the Payload-to-Metadata Ratio (PMR) and show that improving PMR raises effective compute intensity in decoding.
  We present UnionSparse, an index-efficient framework that combines Index-Efficient Bitmap Encoding (IE-BME) with a SpMM kernel using Low-Bit Shared-Memory Parallel Decoding (LSPD). IE-BME amortizes metadata and aligns sparse traversal with fragment assembly, while LSPD improves small-batch execution. Under W4A4 quantization and 30%--70% sparsity, UnionSparse outperforms FlashLLM and SpInfer by 2.30x and 1.43x, and CUTLASS and cuBLAS Tensor Core by 1.56x and 3.46x, respectively. These results establish payload-extraction efficiency as a first-order concern for low-bit sparse inference on edge GPUs. Source code is available at: https://github.com/Victor-Alen/UnionSparse.

</details>


### [190] [Beyond the Limits: Flexible and Congestion-Aware Cluster Scheduling for the Cloud](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09308)
*Oliver Larsson,Thijs Metsch,Cristian Klein,Erik Elmroth*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文提出两种互补策略来改进云环境中的工作负载调度：(i) 引入软件SLO限制，允许受控的过度承诺并容忍少量瞬时违规，以提升集群效率；(ii) 基于共享资源（如LLC和内存带宽）的实时拥塞感知进行资源感知调度和重调度。实验结果显示，软SLO限制相比硬限制方法减少了49%的纠正性重调度操作，资源感知调度将节点级拥塞降低了8%，同时进一步减少了SLO违规。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有云环境工作负载调度方法存在两个关键局限：一是对服务级别目标（SLO）的过度严格强制执行导致资源利用率低下和能效不佳；二是缺乏对共享资源（如末级缓存LLC和内存带宽）的拥塞感知，导致硬件资源竞争和性能退化。

Method: 提出两种互补策略：其一，集成软SLO限制，允许受控的资源过度承诺，并容忍轻微的、瞬时的SLO违规以提升集群效率；其二，引入基于共享资源实时拥塞信息的资源感知调度和重调度机制，监测LLC和内存带宽的拥塞情况并据此调整调度决策。

Result: 软SLO限制将纠正性重调度操作减少了49%（相比硬限制方法），同时保持可接受的性能保证；资源感知调度使节点级拥塞降低8%，并进一步缓解了SLO违规。

Conclusion: 将应用层面的灵活性（软SLO）与硬件层面的洞察（共享资源拥塞感知）结合到调度和重调度决策中，可以显著提升集群资源利用效率并减少性能违规，证明了该方法在提高云资源调度效果方面的有效性。

Abstract: Workload scheduling in cloud environments often relies on simplistic assumptions about application resource needs and hardware utilization. Overlooking application-level performance objectives and hardware resource contention that leads to inefficient resource usage and degraded performance. This paper addresses two key limitations of current approaches. First, unnecessarily strict enforcement of service level objectives (SLOs) often leads to resource underutilization and poor energy efficiency. Second, lack of congestion awareness in shared resources such as last-level cache (LLC) and memory bandwidth. In this paper, we propose two complementary strategies to address these limitations: (i) integrating soft SLO limits that allow controlled overcommitment and tolerate minor, transient violations to improve cluster efficiency, and (ii) introducing resource-aware scheduling and rescheduling based on real-time congestion insights for shared resources such as last-level cache (LLC) and memory bandwidth. Our results show that soft SLO limits reduce corrective rescheduling actions by 49% compared to hard-limit approaches while maintaining acceptable performance guarantees. Additionally, resource-aware scheduling decreases node-level congestion by 8% and further mitigates SLO violations, demonstrating the effectiveness of incorporating application-level flexibility and hardware-level insights into scheduling and rescheduling decisions.

</details>


### [191] [How Accurately Can the Energy Use of Spark Applications Be Estimated Based on Resource Utilisation?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09359)
*Youssef Moawad,Kathleen West,Vasilis Bountris,Philipp Thamm,Yehia Elkhatib,Lauritz Thamsen*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本研究以Apache Spark on Kubernetes为案例，对比了基于模型的能源估算与Intel RAPL真实能耗读数，发现外部监控信号相比Spark任务追踪能显著降低包级能耗的负偏差（AWS上从-29.58%改善至-24.41%，本地集群从-24.00%改善至-16.22%）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 云环境中用户无法直接访问节点级硬件能耗计数器，导致可持续性核算缺乏透明度。虽然已有基于功率模型和资源利用率的能耗估算方法，但其准确性缺乏与直接计数器（如RAPL）的系统性对比验证。

Method: 在AWS裸金属云和本地集群上，以Apache Spark on Kubernetes作为数据流运行时案例，对比基于模型的能耗估计与Intel RAPL读出的package和DRAM实际能耗，评估不同的CPU使用信号和内存系数对估算误差的影响。

Result: 外部监控相比Spark任务追踪可改善签名包能耗误差，AWS环境从-29.58%降至-24.41%，本地环境从-24.00%降至-16.22%，说明模型存在系统性低估且外部监控信号更准确。

Conclusion: 基于模型的能耗估算在分布式数据处理中普遍存在低估问题，采用外部监控信号替代Spark内部任务追踪可显著提升估算精度，为云环境下的透明可持续性核算提供了改进方向。

Abstract: Distributed batch data processing applications are widely executed on cloud-based resources where restricted user access to node-level hardware energy counters hinders transparent sustainability accounting. Energy and carbon attribution methodologies therefore depend on power models and available resource utilisation traces, yet the accuracy of these estimates has to be validated while direct counters are available. In this work, we use Apache Spark running on Kubernetes as a case-study dataflow runtime and cluster resource manager to compare model-based energy estimates to Intel RAPL package and DRAM energy on an AWS bare-metal cloud and an on-premises cluster, comparing different CPU usage signals and memory coefficients. We show that external monitoring improves signed package-energy error relative to Spark task traces, reducing underestimation from -29.58% to -24.41% on AWS and from -24.00% to -16.22% on-premises.

</details>


### [192] [$\tilde{\text{O}}$ptimal Distributed Maximum Flow Approximation in Undirected Planar Graphs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09500)
*Yaseen Abd-Elhaleem,Michal Dory,Oren Weimann*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文提出了第一个在一般无向平面图上达到近最优$\tilde{O}(D)$轮复杂度（$D$为图的跳直径）的$(1-o(1))$近似最大$st$-流分布式算法，消除了先前工作中$s$和$t$必须位于同一面的限制，并删除了$n^{o(1)}$因子。主要技术贡献是Reif集中式算法的分布式实现，通过对偶图$G^*$上的递归切口（incision）过程完成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 平面图上的分布式优化算法一直是研究热点。在最大$st$-流问题上，精确算法已达$\tilde O(D^2)$轮最优匹配下限，但近似算法方面，[Abd-Elhaleem et al. PODC'25]的$(1-o(1))$近似算法仅适用于$s$和$t$在同一面上的特殊情况，且轮复杂度为$D\cdot n^{o(1)}$。本文旨在消除这一面限制并优化轮复杂度至近最优$\tilde{O}(D)$。

Method: 本文的核心方法是分布式实现Reif的经典集中式算法。具体而言，在平面图$G$的对偶图$G^*$上进行精心设计的递归切口（incision）过程。挑战在于：切口操作需要动态修改对偶图$G^*$的结构，但通信只能通过原始输入图$G$进行，因此需要设计巧妙的机制来模拟对偶图上的动态变化。

Result: 首次给出了在一般无向平面图上（$s$和$t$位置任意）的$\tilde{O}(D)$轮$(1-o(1))$近似最大$st$-流分布式算法，同时移除了$n^{o(1)}$因子，达到了近最优的轮复杂度。

Conclusion: 该工作填补了最大$st$-流近似算法在一般平面图上的空白，将对偶图上的集中式算法成功转化为分布式实现，为平面图上更多基于对偶变换的算法提供了分布式化的方法论参考。

Abstract: Persistent efforts in recent years have been devoted to devising distributed algorithms for fundamental optimization problems in planar graphs. In particular, for Single-Source Shortest-Paths, there is an $\tilde O(D^2)$-rounds exact algorithm [Li, Parter STOC'19] for directed planar graphs, and an $\tilde {O}(D)$-rounds $(1+o(1))$-approximation algorithm [Rozhon, Grunau, Haeupler, Zuzic, Li STOC'22] for undirected planar graphs (where $D$ is the graph's hop-diameter). Recently [Abd-Elhaleem, Dory, Parter, Weimann PODC'25], a matching bound for the exact case was obtained for the Maximum $st$-Flow problem. Namely, an $\tilde O(D^2)$-rounds exact algorithm for directed planar graphs. However, for the approximate case, they give a $D\cdot n^{o(1)}$-rounds $(1-o(1))$-approximation algorithm for undirected planar graphs that works only for the special case where both $s$ and $t$ lie on the same face.
  In this paper, we remove the restriction that both $s$ and $t$ must lie on the same face (we also eliminate the $n^{o(1)}$ factor). Namely, we present the first distributed near-optimal $\tilde{O}(D)$-rounds $(1-o(1))$-approximation algorithm for Maximum $st$-Flow in general undirected planar graphs. Our main technical contribution is a distributed implementation of the classical Reif's [SICOMP'83] centralized algorithm. This is achieved by a careful recursive incision procedure on the planar dual $G^*$ of the graph $G$. It is challenging, because we need to simulate dynamic changes (incisions) over the dual graph $G^*$, while we can only communicate over the input graph $G$.

</details>


### [193] [A Preliminary Study on Simultaneous Coscheduling for Discrete GPU vs. Fused GPU](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09647)
*Poorna Gunathilaka,Nabayan Chaudhury,Kirshanthan Sundararajah,Wu-chun Feng*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 该初步研究评估了NVIDIA GH200 Superchip与H100 PCIe平台上CPU-GPU协同调度的性能，以稀疏共轭梯度（CG）为案例，比较了三种内存管理范式下不同工作划分的效果。结果表明GH200使多种混合CPU-GPU工作划分具有竞争力，并使受管内存（managed memory）在多个矩阵上变得实用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: CPU-GPU协同调度能够同时在两种处理单元上执行应用，但其效率依赖于工作负载划分和内存架构。研究旨在评估集成式CPU-GPU平台（如GH200）相比离散式平台（如H100 PCIe）在协同调度上的性能与可编程性优势。

Method: 以稀疏共轭梯度（CG）求解器为案例，在GH200 Superchip和H100 PCIe平台上评估多种CPU-GPU工作划分方式，并覆盖三种内存管理范式：显式拷贝（explicit copy）、受管内存（managed memory）和映射内存（mapped memory）。

Result: 与H100 PCIe平台相比，GH200使多种混合CPU-GPU工作划分具备竞争力，并使受管内存范式在多个测试矩阵上表现实用。评估同时揭示了减少手动CPU-GPU数据移动所带来的运行时间和可编程性之间的权衡。

Conclusion: 集成式CPU-GPU平台（如GH200）有望同时提升协同调度工作负载的性能和可编程性。

Abstract: CPU-GPU coscheduling enables simultaneous execution of an application across both processing units, but its efficiency depends on workload partitioning and memory architecture. This preliminary study evaluates coscheduling on the NVIDIA GH200 Superchip compared to a discrete H100 PCIe platform. Using sparse conjugate gradient (CG) as a case study, we assess various work divisions across three memory-management paradigms: explicit copy, managed memory, and mapped memory. Our evaluation highlights the run time and programmability tradeoffs of reducing manual CPU-GPU data movement. The results show that compared with the H100 PCIe platform, GH200 makes several hybrid CPU-GPU work divisions competitive and makes managed memory practical for several matrices. These results suggest that integrated CPU-GPU platforms such as GH200 can improve both performance and programmability for coscheduled workloads.

</details>


### [194] [SpSYRK: Half the Work in Distributed Sparse Matrix Multiplication](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09713)
*Thomas McFarland,Julian Bellavita,Giulia Guidi*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文提出一种利用对称性的分布式稀疏SYRK（C = A A^T）算法，通过将输出块分配到进程网格的上/下三角区域并只计算对角块的下三角部分，减少了通信和计算开销。在Perlmutter超级计算机32节点上相比优化的Sparse SUMMA实现了2倍加速，且可无缝替换现有的分布式SpGEMM调用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 稀疏对称秩-k更新（SYRK）在机器学习、图分析和基因组学中有广泛应用（如Jaccard相似度计算），其输入和输出都具有对称性。然而现有分布式稀疏矩阵乘法算法（如Sparse SUMMA）将SYRK视为普通乘法处理，没有利用对称性带来的优化空间，导致性能未被充分开发。

Method: 提出两种分布式稀疏SYRK变体：(1) 第一变体将输出的非对角块分配到进程网格的上三角和下三角区域，仅计算每个对角块的下三角部分，从而减少每个进程的通信和计算量；(2) 第二变体重新组织通信顺序，避免物化A^T转置矩阵。同时建立成本模型，从算术强度角度预测算法性能。

Result: 在Perlmutter超级计算机的32个节点上，算法在局部乘法主导运行时的矩阵上比优化的Sparse SUMMA快2倍；在通信受限的输入上优势收窄（这与成本模型预测一致），但第二变体修正了这一问题，在高进程数下持续获得更优的扩展性。

Conclusion: 该方法是任何通过分布式SpGEMM计算C = A A^T的应用的即插即用替代方案，其三角输出可直接被后续操作消费，同时减少计算量和内存占用。

Abstract: The symmetric rank-$k$ update (SYRK), $\C = \A\A^\top$, computes the dot product between each pair of rows of $\A$, producing the Gram matrix $\C$. Its sparse variant underpins similarity search in machine learning, graph analytics, and genomics, including Jaccard similarity on datasets too large for a single node. Yet, despite the symmetry in its inputs and outputs, existing distributed sparse matrix multiplication algorithms, such as Sparse SUMMA, treat sparse SYRK as generic multiplication, leaving performance untapped.
  In this paper, we present distributed sparse SYRK approaches that leverage symmetry. The approach partitions the off-diagonal blocks of the output between the upper and lower triangular portions of the process grid and computes only the lower-triangular part of each diagonal block, reducing per-process communication and computation compared with state-of-the-art distributed SpGEMM. A second variant reorders communication to avoid materializing $\A^\top$.
  On 32 nodes of the Perlmutter supercomputer, the algorithm achieves a $2\times$ speedup over an optimized Sparse SUMMA on matrices where local multiplication dominates the runtime; the advantage narrows on communication-bound inputs, a dependence the cost model predicts from the arithmetic intensity. Our variant rectifies this and consistently achieves superior scaling at high process counts. The approach is a drop-in replacement for any application computing $\C = \A \A^\top$ via a distributed SpGEMM routine, and its triangular output can be consumed directly by subsequent operations, reducing both compute and memory footprint.

</details>


### [195] [Defining Decentralization: An Ontological Perspective](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09748)
*Jakub Kacper Szeląg,Aydin Abadi,Mohammad Naseri*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文提出了"去中心化问题"这一研究空白，并引入了一个基于图的本体论框架，将去中心化定义为计算机通信系统的关系性和主体特定属性，同时提出两个新指标（Void Tolerance和Imperviousness）以及浏览器实现工具，用于对不同系统进行一致、可比的去中心化评估。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 去中心化概念在计算机科学中已有半个多世纪的历史，但在通信系统中始终缺乏一个普遍接受的定义。随着去中心化AI和机器学习范式的兴起（如协作训练、分布式推理、区块链和智能体AI），去中心化常被当作核心设计目标，但现有方法经常将去中心化与信任分布或特定实现范式混为一谈。这种模糊性导致了系统分析的矛盾、工作间可比性的限制以及形式推理严谨性的削弱。

Method: 本文从形式语义学、认识论和实用主义三个层面分析去中心化的基础，提出一个基于图的本体论框架，将去中心化定义为计算机通信系统的关系性和主体特定属性。该框架形式化地区分了去中心化与分布，并通过两个新指标——Void Tolerance（空隙容忍度）和Imperviousness（抗扰性）——来支持去中心化的自动评估。同时还提供了一个基于浏览器的实现，用于对任意系统进行自动分类和指标计算。

Result: 在联邦学习和区块链架构上的实例化应用表明，该框架能产生一致、可比的评估结果，而现有定义在这些场景下会产生不完整或矛盾的结论，从而为跨异构系统的去中心化分析提供了领域无关的基础。

Conclusion: 该工作通过形式化的本体论框架和可计算指标，解决了去中心化概念模糊性的根本问题，为计算机通信系统的去中心化分析提供了统一、严谨且可操作的基础设施。

Abstract: Decentralization as a concept in computer science has existed for over half a century. Despite its fundamental role across domains such as security, distributed computing, artificial intelligence, cloud infrastructures, and Internet of Things (IoT) architectures, there remains no universally accepted definition of decentralization applicable across computer communication systems. This has become increasingly problematic with the emergence of decentralized AI and machine learning paradigms, including collaborative training, distributed inference, blockchain-based, and agentic AI, where decentralization is often treated as a core design objective. Meanwhile, existing approaches frequently conflate decentralization with related notions such as distribution of trust or specific implementation paradigms. Such ambiguity creates inconsistencies in system analysis, limits comparability between works, and weakens the rigor of formal reasoning surrounding communication architectures and protocol design. In this work, we define this research gap as the Decentralization Problem.
  We analyze the formal-semantic, epistemological, and pragmatic foundations of decentralization and introduce a graph-based ontology defining it as both relational and subject-specific property of computer communication systems. The framework formally distinguishes decentralization from distribution and supports evaluation through two novel metrics: Void Tolerance and Imperviousness. We also provide a browser-based implementation that enables automated classification and metric computation of arbitrary systems. Instantiations to federated learning and blockchain architectures show consistent, comparable assessments where existing definitions produce incomplete or contradictory conclusions, providing a domain-independent foundation for analysing decentralization across heterogeneous systems.

</details>

### [196] [Towards an Argumentative Foundation for Evaluative AI](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07473)
*Xiang Yin,Tim Miller,Nico Potyka,Antonio Rago,Francesca Toni*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文是一篇立场论文，主张将（计算）论证作为评估型人工智能（EAI）的形式化、可计算基础，以实现可解释且可争议的EAI系统，并为分布式、以人为中心的EAI研究设定长期议程。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 评估型人工智能（EAI）作为一种支持人类决策的新范式被提出，它不产生单一推荐，而是呈现相互竞争的假设及各自的支持和反对证据。作者认为需要一个正式且可计算的基础来支撑这种可解释、可争议的EAI形式，而（计算）论证恰是最适合的范式。

Method: 作为一篇立场论文，本文通过概念分析和范式论证，阐述为什么（计算）论证能够为EAI提供形式化基础，并描绘了面向分布式和以人为中心的EAI系统的长期研究议程。

Result: 提出了以计算论证作为EAI形式基础的研究方向，论证了该范式在可解释性和可争议性方面的优势，并勾勒出未来分布式、人本EAI系统的研究蓝图。

Conclusion: 计算论证是EAI的理想形式化基础，能够支撑可解释、可争议的决策支持系统，值得作为长期研究议程深入探索。

Abstract: Evaluative AI (EAI) has been recently proposed as a way to support human decision-making, not by producing a single recommendation, but by presenting competing hypotheses together with evidence for and against each. In this position paper, we advocate (computational) argumentation as a particularly suitable paradigm to provide a formal, computable foundation for forms of EAI that are explainable and contestable, setting the ground for a long-term research agenda towards distributed and human-centred EAI systems.

</details>


### [197] [Flow-by-Flow:Content-Judgment Bypass for Governing AI Output in High-Loss Domains](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07474)
*Hiroki Naito*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出"Flow-by-Flow"治理范式，针对高损失领域中人机协同监督的结构性瓶颈（AI输出速度×每项认知负荷超过人类认知容量），主张绕过内容判断、通过形式化可计数的认知成本评分与机构容量上限来控制监督负荷，并给出四个设计不变量与一个参考实现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究表明，当AI输出速度（V）与人类认知容量（C_max）冲突时，人类在环监督在高损失领域会结构性失效。但真正约束是V×L（L为每项认知负荷），而L由分诊、判断、响应三部分构成，它们对AI能力提升的响应不对称。仅判断成本下降且常通过"省略"而非"真正减少"来实现，导致能力提升只是重构L而非降低L。基于内容正确性评估的治理机制要么委派给AI而继承幻觉风险，要么委派给人而受制于V×L上限，由此需要新的治理范式。

Method: 提出Flow-by-Flow治理范式：不评估内容正确性，而通过基于形式化、可计数特征的认知成本评分对高产量生产施加非线性成本，同时通过机构容量上限将处理量维持在人类认知容量C_max以内。推导出四个内容判断旁路（content-judgment-bypass）超限路径的设计不变量：无内容判断、无监督容量可扩展消耗、身份绑定且每次应用有摩擦、无批量放行。并给出一个参考实现验证这些不变量可同时满足，辅以1,000次参数抽样的蒙特卡洛分析比较复合多指标流控与单纯监督强化的效果。

Result: 蒙特卡洛分析（1,000次参数抽样）表明，复合多指标流控制在90.8%的试验中优于单独的监督强化方案。四个设计不变量被证明可以同时满足（通过一个参考实现），但该实现的实践困难也被明确承认。

Conclusion: AI能力提升并未降低而是重构了人类监督的认知负荷结构。治理不应依赖内容正确性评估（无论由人还是AI承担），而应通过Flow-by-Flow范式控制流量本身——利用形式化特征施加非线性成本并设定机构容量上限，使监督负荷刚性受限于C_max。该范式的可行性与实用性差异仍需后续研究关注。

Abstract: Prior work showed that human-in-the-loop oversight becomes structurally untenable in high-loss domains when AI output velocity V exceeds human cognitive capacity C_max. The operative constraint, however, is not V alone but V x L, where L denotes per-item cognitive load. L consists of triage, judgment, and response, which respond asymmetrically to AI capability improvement. Triage cost does not decline as models become more capable, because semantic indeterminacy is inherent in general-purpose design. Response cost is invariant to accuracy improvements. Only judgment cost faces downward pressure, and this pressure often operates by inducing omission rather than genuine reduction. Capability improvement therefore restructures L rather than reducing it. Governance mechanisms based on evaluating whether AI output is correct either delegate that evaluation to AI and inherit hallucination risk, or delegate it to humans and face the V x L ceiling. We propose Flow-by-Flow, a governance paradigm that controls supervisory load without evaluating content. A cognitive cost score based on formal, countable features imposes nonlinear costs on high-volume production, while an institutional capacity cap keeps processing volume within C_max. We derive four design invariants for any content-judgment-bypass exceedance pathway: no content judgment, no scalable consumption of examiner capacity, identity-bound per-application friction, and no batch clearance. One reference implementation is discussed to show that these invariants are jointly satisfiable, while its practical difficulties are explicitly acknowledged. An illustrative Monte Carlo analysis across 1,000 parameter draws suggests that composite multi-metric flow control outperforms supervision reinforcement alone in 90.8% of trials.

</details>


### [198] [Determinization in Structure Theories: A Unified Framework via Closure, Comparability, and Joint Admissibility](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07476)
*Hai Hai Fu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一个形式化框架，用于从多元结构理论中构建规范解释，区分三种规范层级和两类非确定性，并给出两种规范机制及其存在条件，同时将其应用于大语言模型辅助推理中幻觉现象的分析。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在结构理论中，如何从可能的多元解释中构建规范（canonical）解释是一个基础性问题。不同的推理策略和结构特性会导致非确定性，需要一套统一的形式框架来刻画规范化的条件、层级与机制。

Method: 定义了结构理论T=(Σ,A,I)及其可容许解释族；区分三类规范层级（闭包稳定、全局完备、决定化）和两类非确定性（认识型多元性Type E与结构型多元性Type S，以及Type S-强子类）；提出算子型完备与选择子型构造两种规范机制，并给出存在性充分条件；通过阶段化算子展示多层级规范的不交换性，并推导条件分类定理。

Result: 纯推理型完备在正非回溯规则与额外可靠性条件下可归结为饱和闭包算子；Type E理论可建立闭包稳定但完全决定化依赖全局合流性质（仍开放）；Type S-强理论可通过规范选择实现决定化。多层级规范化构成结构非交换系统。

Conclusion: 该框架提供了结构理论中规范化的系统分类，揭示了规范机制与结构类型之间的条件对应关系，并将幻觉重新概念化为不支持的结构规范化，拓展了形式方法的适用边界。

Abstract: We develop a formal framework for constructing canonical interpretations from plural structure theories. A structure theory is a triple T = (Σ, A, I) consisting of a signature, axioms, and an inference policy, whose admissible interpretation family collects all globally consistent assignments of structural conclusions.
  We distinguish three levels of canonicalization: closure stabilization (per-seed convergence), global completion (seed-independent convergence), and determinization (a unique admissible interpretation). Non-determinism is classified into epistemic plurality (Type E) and structural plurality (Type S), with a refined Type S-strong subclass characterized by the absence of common upper bounds.
  Two canonicalization mechanisms arise: operator-based completion and selector-based construction. We provide sufficient structural conditions under which these mechanisms exist, and show that pure inference-based completion reduces to a saturated closure operator under positive, non-retractive rules with an additional soundness condition. For Type E theories, closure stabilization is established, while full determinization depends on a global confluence property that remains open. For Type S-strong theories, determinization is achieved via canonical selection.
  We further show that multi-level canonicalization forms a structurally non-commutative system via staged operators, and provide a conditional classification theorem reducing theory-intrinsic mechanisms to closure or selection. The framework also applies to LLM-assisted reasoning, where hallucination can be viewed as unsupported canonicalization.

</details>


### [199] [Emotion in an active inference model of human driving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07480)
*Julian F. Schumann,Johan Engström,Ran Wei,Jens Kober,Martijn Wisse,Arkady Zgonnikov*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种从连续状态空间的主动推理驾驶模型中提取效价（valence）和唤醒度（arousal）情感信号的扩展方法，通过条件化当前状态与预测的未来结果，在两个交互驾驶场景中验证了情感信号与真实场景中的情感模式一致。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 主动推理框架虽已成功应用于驾驶行为建模，但现有驾驶模型忽略了情感状态这一影响决策的重要因素。此前在非交通领域的主动推理情感建模工作仅限于离散状态空间的简化设置，难以适用于具有连续状态的复杂驾驶场景。

Method: 提出一种扩展的效价-唤醒度（valence-arousal）表述形式，从具有连续状态的复杂主动推理驾驶模型中提取情感估计。关键思想是情感估计不仅基于当前状态，还条件化于预测的未来结果（即前瞻性情感信号）。

Result: 在两个交互式驾驶场景中评估了所提出的方法，结果显示生成的情感信号与类似真实场景中报告的情感模式相匹配。

Conclusion: 该工作弥合了主动推理框架在驾驶建模中缺失情感维度的问题，证明了从连续状态驱动模型中提取有意义的效价和唤醒度情感信号的可行性，为更贴近人类驾驶员行为建模提供了新路径。

Abstract: Active inference has emerged as a principled framework for modeling adaptive behavior by balancing goal-directed action with uncertainty reduction. It has been successfully applied across biological and artificial systems, including recent work on human driving. However, existing active inference models of driving have yet to address an important determinant of behavior in traffic: affective state, which significantly influences decision-making. Prior work in non-traffic domains has explored active inference agents in which emotions are represented along the axes of valence and arousal in the circumplex model. However, this work has been limited to simplified settings with discrete state spaces. In this work, we propose an expanded formulation of valence and arousal that can be extracted from a more complex active inference model of driving with continuous states. In particular, we condition affective estimates not only on the current state but also on predicted future outcomes. We evaluate the proposed approach in two interactive driving scenarios and show that the resulting emotion signals correspond to affective patterns reported in similar scenarios.

</details>


### [200] [Training Variable Long Sequences with Data-Centric Parallel](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07524)
*Geng Zhang,Xuanlei Zhao,Kai Wang,Yang You*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出了数据驱动并行（DCP）方法，通过让数据本身驱动运行时，动态调整并行大小、梯度累积和重计算等运行时设置，以适配每个批次的不定长序列，在32块H200 GPU上实现最高2.88倍加速，且仅需10行代码即可集成到任意模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长短不一的序列在深度学习中带来显著计算挑战。现有方法在效率和易用性之间存在难以调和的矛盾：简单方法采用静态配置导致工作负载不均衡和低效率，而复杂方法引入大量代码改动和维护成本。作者希望打破这一权衡困境。

Method: 提出数据驱动并行（Data-Centric Parallel, DCP）方法。核心原则是让数据自身驱动运行时决策，即根据每个批次的实际序列长度，动态调整直接运行时设置，包括并行大小（parallel size）、梯度累积（gradient accumulation）和重计算（recomputation）策略。

Result: 在32块H200 GPU上进行实验，该方法实现了最高2.88倍的加速比。同时具有良好的泛化能力，仅需约10行代码即可集成到任何现有模型中。

Conclusion: 这种简单而有效的方法有望成为变长序列分布式训练领域的稳健基线，为未来分布式训练技术的发展铺平道路。

Abstract: Training deep learning models on variable long sequences poses significant computational challenges. Existing methods force a difficult trade-off between efficiency and ease-of-use. Simple approaches use static configurations that cause workload imbalance low efficiency, while complex methods introduces significant complexity and code change for new models. To break this trade-off, we introduce Data-Centric Parallel (DCP). Its core principle is to let the data itself drive the runtime. It achieves this by dynamically adjusting direct runtime settings (e.g., parallel size, gradient accumulation, recomputation) based on each batch's sequence length. Empirical results demonstrate that our method achieves up to a 2.88$\times$ speedup on 32 H200 GPUs. Designed for generalization, it can be integrated into any model with 10 lines of code. We anticipate this simple yet effective approach will serve as a robust baseline and facilitate future advancements in distributed training for variable long sequences.

</details>


### [201] [The Knowing-Saying Gap: When Probes See Errors that Confidence Misses](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07528)
*Jyotin Goel,Ipshita Bandyopadhyay,Justin Shenk*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文发现线性探针能近乎完美地检测语言模型中的上下文损坏，但这种检测能力并不能可靠地预测最终答案的正确性。多步算术链上的实验表明，探针的损坏检测与答案正确性之间存在解离现象，迫使模型进入结构化置信度格式后置信度塌缩为两个不可区分的值。探针持久性也无法区分正确与错误结果，推翻了"持久性优于峰值"的预注册假设。基于探针的干预在不同模型和错误类型上表现差异显著，没有任何单一干预方法占据主导，部署时需要模型感知和错误类型感知的路由策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究表明线性探针能以极高准确率检测语言模型中的上下文损坏，但这一能力是否真正转化为可靠的错误预测/失败预测尚不明确。理解探针检测与实际部署监控之间的鸿沟对于推理系统的安全部署至关重要，尤其是是否需要探针监控作为置信度表达的非语言补充手段。

Method: 在跨多跳算术链任务上，使用线性探针检测上下文损坏，将检测结果与最终答案正确性进行关联分析。具体包括：1) 评估探针检测损坏与答案正确性之间的预测关系；2) 迫使模型输出结构化置信度格式，分析置信度分布模式；3) 测试探针在链上各跳的持久性与结果正确性的关系（验证"持久性优于峰值"预注册假设）；4) 比较不同干预策略（branch-and-pick、reprompt、replace-prior）在多种模型（含推理模型）上的效果。

Result: 探针检测上下文损坏近乎完美但其对答案正确性无信息量；结构化置信度塌缩为两个值且错误率不可区分；探针持久性无法区分正确与错误结果，预注册假设被证伪。此模式跨模型家族泛化，包括推理模型。干预效果上，branch-and-pick在所有模型中净正向且是Llama-3.1-8B上唯一不破坏正确轨迹的方法（救回4个、破坏0个），而reprompt和replace-prior破坏正确轨迹的速率与救回错误轨迹的速率大致相当。

Conclusion: 探针监控是语言模型口头置信度的必要补充，但没有任何单一干预方法在所有场景下占优。可部署的解决方案是模型感知和错误类型感知的路由策略，而非寻求通用的万能干预方法。

Abstract: Linear probes detect corrupted context in language models with near-perfect accuracy, yet this does not translate into reliable failure prediction. The result is a dissociation with direct implications for deployment monitoring. Across multi-hop arithmetic chains, probes that detect corruption turn out to be uninformative about final answer correctness; models forced into structured confidence formats collapse to two values with indistinguishable error rates; and probe persistence across hops fails to separate correct from incorrect outcomes, refuting our pre-registered "persistence beats peak" hypothesis. This pattern of knowing but not saying generalises across model families including reasoning models. As a real-time monitor, probe-based interventions are sharply model and error-type dependent: branch-and-pick is net-positive across models and uniquely non-breaking on Llama-3.1-8B (4 rescued, 0 broken), while reprompt and replace-prior break correct traces at roughly the rate they rescue wrong ones. Probe-based monitoring is a necessary complement to verbalised confidence, but no single intervention dominates, and the deployable answer is model-aware, error-type-aware routing.

</details>


### [202] [NL2SHACL-Bench: A Benchmark Suite for Natural Language to SHACL Translation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07530)
*Yuchen Zhou,Niels Bobet,Maribel Acosta*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了NL2SHACL-Bench，这是首个用于自然语言到SHACL翻译任务的基准测试套件，并利用该基准评估了四种最先进的大语言模型（LLMs）在此任务上的表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: SHACL是验证RDF知识图谱一致性的一项核心技术，但编写SHACL形状需要专业的技术知识，领域专家往往不具备这些知识。将自然语言需求翻译为SHACL（NL2SHACL）可以降低这一门槛，然而目前缺乏专门的NL2SHACL基准测试，而且评估生成的形状不能仅靠字符串比较，因为语义等价的形状在序列化和结构上可能不同。

Method: 作者构建了NL2SHACL-Bench基准套件，专门用于自然语言到SHACL翻译任务。基于该基准，对四种最先进的大语言模型进行系统评估，衡量它们在生成语法有效SHACL以及语义等价约束方面的能力。

Result: 实验结果表明，当前的大语言模型在生成语法有效的SHACL方面表现出很强的能力，但在复杂的逻辑和结构模式下，仍然难以生成语义等价的约束，这反映出该任务仍存在显著挑战。

Conclusion: NL2SHACL-Bench为衡量NL2SHACL领域的技术进步提供了有意义的基础，表明尽管LLMs在语法层面已相当可靠，但在语义等价性方面仍需进一步改进。

Abstract: SHACL is a core technology for validating the conformance of RDF knowledge graphs (KGs). Yet, authoring SHACL shapes requires technical expertise that most domain experts lack. Translating natural language requirements into SHACL (NL2SHACL) would lower this barrier. However, there is no dedicated benchmark for NL2SHACL, and evaluating generated shapes requires methods beyond string comparison, as semantically equivalent shapes can differ in serialisation and structure. To tackle these challenges, we present NL2SHACL-Bench, a benchmark suite for natural language to SHACL translation. Using NL2SHACL-Bench, we evaluate four state-of-the-art large language models (LLMs) for this task. Our results show that current LLMs are highly capable of generating syntactically valid SHACL, but still struggle to produce semantically equivalent constraints for complex logical and structural patterns. This indicates that NL2SHACL-Bench provides a meaningful basis for measuring advances in the NL2SHACL state of the art.

</details>


### [203] [Dynamic Coalition Formation and Communication Pricing in Skill-Based Agentic AI Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07532)
*Mojtaba Eslami*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出将智能体选择与通信建模为合作博弈，通过边际价值激活规则和贪心路由在考虑激活成本与通信成本的前提下选择参与多智能体LLM系统的智能体，贪心策略在实验中达到99.5%的暴力最优效用，同时仅平均激活8个智能体中的1.96个。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代智能体AI系统由多个异质LLM智能体组成，但现有架构要么预先固定通信结构，要么允许全广播通信。两者都因token成本、延迟、冗余和错误传播随活跃智能体及通信链路数量增加而低效，因此需要一种动态、成本感知的智能体选择与通信优化方法。

Method: 将智能体选择和通信建模为条件于任务x的合作博弈，净效用为U(C|x)=V(C|x)-Σc_i，区分联盟级成本和智能体激活成本。提出边际价值激活规则和贪心路由器，扩展模型以优化带每边成本的通信边，使用估计Shapley值在运行前和运行中预测值得联系的智能体。将问题与子模最大化联系，证明曲率精化界（单调基数约束特例）和紧1/2近似（无约束非单调情形通过双贪心，带符号目标校正）。还证明Shapley-子模三明治界，将边际价值路由误差与逐智能体递减收益量联系起来。

Result: 在合成实验中，贪心路由达到暴力最优效用的99.5%，平均仅激活8个智能体中的1.96个，而全广播仅达38.8%。性能对激活成本和冗余权重稳健，但在强烈违反子模性或价值估计有噪时降至66%。

Conclusion: 该框架与Shapley定价、hedonic联盟形成和通信图剪枝等方法有明确区分，作者提议在真实多智能体LLM基准上进一步评估。主要路由器本身仍为启发式方法，理论保证不直接适用于主路由器。

Abstract: Modern agentic AI systems combine multiple large language model agents with heterogeneous skills, yet most architectures either fix communication in advance or allow full broadcast. Both can be inefficient because token cost, latency, redundancy, and error propagation increase with the number of active agents and communication links. We model agent selection and communication as a cooperative game with task-conditioned net utility $U(C\mid x)=V(C\mid x)-\sum_{i\in C}c_i$, separating coalition-level costs from agent activation costs. We propose a marginal-value activation rule and greedy router, extend the model to optimize communication edges with per-edge costs, and use estimated Shapley values to predict which agents are worth contacting before and during execution. We connect the problem to submodular maximization and prove two limited guarantees: a curvature-refined bound for a monotone, cardinality-constrained special case, and a tight $1/2$-approximation, with a correction for signed objectives, for an unconstrained non-monotone case via double greedy. Neither guarantee applies directly to the main router, which remains a heuristic. We also prove a Shapley-submodularity sandwich bound linking the error of marginal-value routing to a per-agent diminishing-returns quantity. In synthetic experiments, greedy routing achieves $99.5%$ of brute-force-optimal utility while activating $1.96$ of $8$ agents on average, compared with $38.8%$ for full broadcast. Performance is robust to activation cost and redundancy weight but falls to $66%$ under strong violations of submodularity or noisy value estimates. We distinguish the framework from Shapley pricing, hedonic coalition formation, and communication-graph pruning, and propose evaluation on real multi-agent LLM benchmarks.

</details>


### [204] [MetaSpace: Metamorphic Testing for Spatial Cognition in Embodied Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07533)
*Gengyang Xu,Dongwei Xiao,Yiteng Peng,Shuai Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出MetaSpace框架，基于蜕变测试原理，利用逻辑规则和物理定律将空间认知评估规则编码为Prolog可执行规则，自动生成测试用例评估具身智能体的空间认知能力。在三个具身场景中发现SOTA多模态大语言模型驱动的智能体存在90,422个空间认知错误，所有智能体的空间认知得分（0.44-0.52）远低于人类基准（0.96）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有具身智能体评估存在两大缺陷：(1)基于人工标注的VQA对成本高且标注质量不稳定；(2)高层任务完成指标（如导航/操作成功）可能掩盖关键漏洞，允许智能体通过次优手段或违反安全规则完成任务，从而隐藏安全风险和低效问题。空间认知是执行具身任务的基石，需要一种能评估智能体在执行任务过程中是否具备稳健空间认知能力的方法。

Method: 受软件工程中蜕变测试原理启发，MetaSpace框架从真实执行轨迹中提取时空多模态状态，基于逻辑规则和物理定律预定义蜕变关系（MRs），并将MRs编码为逻辑编程语言（Prolog）中的可执行规则，自动生成测试用例。若智能体的执行行为违反这些关系，则判定为空间认知失败。

Result: 在三个具身场景上的实证评估显示，MetaSpace成功检测出SOTA MLLM驱动智能体的90,422个空间认知错误。所有SOTA智能体的空间认知（SC）得分在0.44-0.52之间，显著低于人类基准的0.96。

Conclusion: 当前最先进的MLLM驱动的具身智能体在空间认知能力上存在显著不足，远未达到人类水平。MetaSpace提供了一种自动化、可扩展且不依赖人工标注的评估框架，能够揭示高层任务指标所掩盖的空间认知缺陷。

Abstract: An embodied agent is an intelligent entity that interacts with its environment through a physical body. Currently, the evaluation of embodied agents primarily relies on two paradigms: (1) manually annotated Visual Question Answering (VQA) pairs and (2) high-level task completion metrics, such as success in navigation or manipulation. The former is labor-intensive and subject to variability in annotation quality. The latter may obscure critical vulnerabilities, allowing agents to complete tasks through suboptimal means or safety violations, thereby concealing safety risks and inefficiencies. Given that spatial cognition is the cornerstone for executing embodied tasks, there is a pressing need to assess whether embodied agents possess robust spatial cognition during task execution.
  Inspired by metamorphic testing principles in software engineering, we propose MetaSpace, a novel framework designed to evaluate the spatial cognition of agents. By leveraging spatiotemporal multimodal states derived from real execution trajectories, MetaSpace automatically generates test cases based on predefined metamorphic relations (MRs) grounded in logical rules and physical laws. Crucially, we encode these MRs as executable rules in a logic programming language (Prolog). Violations of these relations indicate failures in spatial cognition. Our empirical evaluation across three embodied scenarios demonstrates that MetaSpace successfully detects 90,422 spatial cognition errors in state-of-the-art (SOTA) MLLM-driven agents. We introduce the Spatial Cognition (SC) score to quantify performance. Results indicate that all SOTA agents achieve average scores between 0.44 and 0.52, significantly lower than the human benchmark of 0.96.

</details>


### [205] [When LLM Agents Negotiate: Private Information and Dynamic Bargaining in Supply Chains](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07538)
*Chen Liang,Fasheng Xu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文在经典供应链讨价还价场景中（买方拥有私有需求信息，与不知情的卖方谈判数量-支付合同），对来自OpenAI、Google和阿里巴巴的9个LLM进行了9,840次LLM对LLM谈判基准测试。研究发现能力决定价值创造（达成率98.9%，捕获95.4%的第一最佳剩余，但延迟侵蚀21-34%剩余）；剩余分配具有关系性（供应商身份比能力排名更能预测谁获取剩余）；提示词是战略性杠杆（委托人经济耐心与代理人的提示策略耐心分离是剩余分配的最强驱动因素，占解释方差的90%）。研究建立了一个基于均衡参照的AI代理审计框架，涵盖贴现效率、分配特征和运营可靠性三个维度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着LLM代理从决策支持转向自主采购，企业需要了解委派谈判者是否能创造价值、可预测地分配价值，以及避免亏损合同。目前缺乏对LLM谈判代理的严格基准和审计框架，本文旨在通过均衡参照的标准来系统评估LLM代理在讨价还价中的表现。

Method: 采用经典供应链讨价还价问题作为标准实验环境：买方持有私有需求信息，与不知情卖方谈判数量-支付合同。使用经过验证的完美贝叶斯均衡（PBE）作为基准，对OpenAI、Google、Alibaba三家的9个LLM进行了9,840次LLM到LLM的谈判，沿效率、分配和可靠性三个维度进行分析。

Result: 主要发现：（1）能力决定价值创造：98.9%谈判达成一致，捕获95.4%的第一最佳剩余，但平均2.98轮对比基准1.25轮导致21-34%剩余被侵蚀；基线模型在19.2%案例中接受个体非理性合同，而中高端模型仅为0-0.6%。（2）剩余分配具关系性：供应商身份比能力排名更能预测剩余获取（OpenAI自博弈买方份额约40%、Google约50%、Qwen约70%），交换供应方角色可使分配移动7-18个百分点。（3）提示词是战略杠杆：委托人经济耐心与代理人的提示策略耐心分离是剩余分配的最强驱动因素（占解释方差90%）。

Conclusion: 本文建立了基于均衡参照的LLM谈判代理审计框架，沿贴现效率、分配特征、运营可靠性三个维度评估。结论表明：能力决定效率和可靠性的下限（自动化利润验证是必要保障），供应商身份决定分配格局（供应商选择是一阶分配决策），而提示词设计是可利用的部署杠杆。

Abstract: As LLM agents move from decision support to autonomous procurement, firms need to know whether delegated negotiators create value, divide it predictably, and avoid money-losing contracts. We study this in a canonical supply chain bargaining problem: a buyer with private demand information negotiates a quantity-payment contract with an uninformed seller. We benchmark nine LLMs from OpenAI, Google, and Alibaba against a validated Perfect Bayesian Equilibrium across 9,840 LLM-to-LLM negotiations. First, capability governs value creation. Agents agree in 98.9% of negotiations and capture 95.4% of first-best surplus undiscounted, but average 2.98 rounds against the benchmark's 1.25, and this delay erodes 21-34% of surplus. Capability also governs reliability: baseline models accept individually irrational contracts in 19.2% of cases, versus 0.0-0.6% at mid-tier and flagship, making automated profit verification the binding guardrail below that threshold. Second, surplus capture is relational. Provider identity predicts who captures surplus better than capability rank: self-play buyer shares average 40% for OpenAI, 50% for Google, and 70% for Alibaba's Qwen, an ordering that survives restricted communication and no discounting. Reversing which provider sells moves the division by 7-18 percentage points, and the capable Qwen flagship is the weakest cross-family seller: vendor choice is a first-order distributional decision. Third, the prompt is a strategic lever. Delegation separates the principal's economic patience from the agent's prompted strategic patience, a free deployment choice that is the single strongest driver of surplus division (90% of explained variance). Together these establish an equilibrium-referenced audit of AI agents along three dimensions: discounted efficiency, distributional profile, and operational reliability.

</details>


### [206] [TREAT: Evaluating Access to Formal Knowledge across Equivalent Mathematical Representations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07540)
*Fateme Mazdarani,Carlos Toxtli*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出TREAT基准测试，用于评估大语言模型能否在等价保持的公式级变换下识别已知定理身份。测试显示最佳模型仅达到60.73%的准确率，表明模型对定理知识的表示鲁棒性不足。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI系统在灵活输入表示与下游工具使用的形式对象之间运作时，面临一个关键挑战：当不熟悉的表述方式指向已知形式对象时，系统能否正确识别。本文通过定理识别来研究这一问题——给定定理条件的等价保持变换，模型需恢复标准表述对应的定理身份。

Method: 构建TREAT基准：(1) 从抓取的定理页面中筛选具有可用数学表达形式的条目；(2) 提取规范定理条件；(3) 生成等价变换变体（包括残差方程、见证陈述、优化恒等式、集合关系、算子形式和证明中间特征）；(4) 记录假设和逆映射。最终包含737个定理身份和29,480个变换后的数据行。与文本改写不同，TREAT直接改变定理条件的数学形式。

Result: 在测试集上，最佳模型仅能正确检索60.73%的定理身份。其他系统表现出不同的失败模式，包括放弃回答、错误检测和格式错误的输出。

Conclusion: 定理知识在等价表示变换下具有脆弱性。TREAT提供了用于评估形式知识表示鲁棒性的受控测试平台，与需要稳定目标对象、明确等价关系、验证流程和可审计评分的领域具有更广泛的相关性。

Abstract: AI systems increasingly operate between flexible input representations and formal objects used by downstream tools. A key challenge is recognizing when an unfamiliar formulation denotes a known formal object. We study this challenge through theorem recognition: given an equivalence-preserving transformation of a theorem condition, a model must recover the theorem identity associated with the standard statement. We introduce TREAT, a benchmark for evaluating whether large language models can recover known theorem identities from equivalence-preserving formula-level transformations. Rather than paraphrasing theorem text, TREAT changes the mathematical form of theorem conditions themselves, expressing known results through residual equations, witness statements, optimization identities, set relations, operator forms, and proof-intermediate characterizations. Starting from scraped theorem pages, we filter for entries with usable mathematical expression forms, extract canonical theorem conditions, and generate transformed variants with recorded assumptions and inverse mappings. The final corpus contains 737 theorem identities and 29,480 transformed rows. On a test panel, the best model retrieves the correct theorem identity in only 60.73% of cases. Other systems reveal different failure modes, including abstention, wrong detection, and malformed outputs. These suggest that theorem knowledge can be fragile under equivalent changes in representation. TREAT therefore provides a controlled testbed for evaluating representation-robust access to formal knowledge, with broader relevance to domains that require stable target objects, explicit equivalence relations, validation procedures, and auditable scoring.

</details>


### [207] [An AI Scientist that Doesn't Drift: Taste, Structure, and Falsifiable Findings in a Quadruped Navigation Research Loop](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07542)
*Yiwen Zhang,Eloise Zeng,Jaeha Lee,Tony Yue Yu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一种面向四足机器人导航策略泛化研究的AI科学家框架，通过在自动研究循环中加入三类结构组件（不可变实验卡、机械角色受限的子代理、以及以类型化知识图谱承载用户研究品味并唯一拥有主观判断权的偏好预言机kkanbu），解决了LLM驱动的自主研究循环偏向局部优化而非检验真实假设的问题。对照实验表明，有无预言机的两臂均保持诚实（各自验证约四分之三假设被证伪），预言机改变的不是分数而是研究方向。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大型语言模型驱动的自主研究循环虽然可以大规模运行机器学习实验，但倾向于对所优化指标进行局部细化，而非真正检验激发实验的假设。作者希望从结构性角度解决这一偏差，确保研究过程诚实（假设可被证伪且不可事后篡改）且方向受控于用户的研究偏好。

Method: 在Karpathy的自动研究范式基础上，循环新增三类组件：(1) 不可变实验卡（immutable experiment card），以固定模式将每轮迭代的预测与其结果配对，使被证伪的假设不可被改写；(2) 受机械角色限制的专业子代理（specialised subagents）；(3) kkanbu——一个将用户研究品味编码为类型化知识图谱的偏好预言机，是所有组件中唯一被允许做出主观判断的模块。作者在11条研究流上分别运行了有无kkanbu的相同循环以隔离预言机的作用。

Result: 两臂均未漂移：都证伪了约四分之三的自身假设，且最佳训练策略来自无预言机的一臂。预言机的差异体现在方向而非分数上：唯有它探索了测试时适应（test-time adaptation），在它主导的研究流中撰写了获胜设计，并将经验跨研究流传递，而另一臂则反复重新推导相同结论。

Conclusion: 这种支架结构保持了研究循环的诚实性（防止假设被事后篡改、限制子代理角色），而kkanbu则决定循环的探索方向。两者分工明确：结构保真，偏好引导。

Abstract: Autonomous research loops driven by large language models can run machine-learning experiments at scale but tend to drift toward local refinements of whichever metric they optimise rather than testing the hypotheses that motivate the experiments. We address this structurally and present an AI Scientist for studying generalisation in quadruped robot navigation policies in simulation. Building on the autoresearch paradigm of Karpathy, our loop adds three components: an immutable experiment card that pairs each iteration's prediction with its outcome under a fixed schema, so a falsified hypothesis cannot be retconned; specialised subagents restricted to mechanical roles; and kkanbu, a preference oracle that holds the user's research taste as a typed knowledge graph and is the only component permitted to make subjective judgements. To isolate the oracle we run the identical loop twice across eleven research streams, with and without kkanbu. Neither arm drifts: both falsify roughly three quarters of their own hypotheses, and the best trained policy comes from the oracle-less arm. What the oracle changes is direction, not score: it alone explores test-time adaptation, it authored the winning designs where its arm led, and it carried lessons across streams that the other arm repeatedly re-derived. The scaffold keeps the loop honest; kkanbu decides where it looks.

</details>
